Conversation/0x010000570000B72A/Title.english: Pick up dice from the Dicemaker

Conversation/0x010000570000F10E/Descript.english: You finally met up with the mysterious smoker on the balcony. He said the one you really want to talk to is his friend. This friend is waiting for you inside, in apartment #28 -- go and and meet him right now (he won't be there later).

Conversation/0x010000570000F10E/Descript.belarusian: Нарэшце ты сустрэўся з таямнічым курцом на гаўбцы. Ён сказаў, што той, з кім табе сапраўды варта пагаварыць, — гэта яго сябар. Гэты сябар чакае цябе ўнутры, у кватэры № 28 — ідзі сустрэнься з ім проста зараз (пасля яго там не будзе).

Conversation/0x0100005700015A01/Descript.english: A balcony with a view to the yard -- *and* the hanging.

Conversation/0x01000057000165E5/Descript.english: You hear distant traffic. Night is falling on the city.

Conversation/0x010000570001922F/Descript.english: The antenna, Ream ESKER AR-1, is buzzing with energy.

Conversation/0x010000570001D6B9/Descript.english: A large demijohn full of strange liquid...

Conversation/0x010000570001D9F8/Descript.english: An old grocery list on the table. And checks.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA0D/Descript.polish: Lokal nr 8. W jego skrzynce brakuje już miejsca.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA1D/Descript.english: Feels eerie here, like someone's tracking you through a peephole...
Conversation/0x010000570001DA1D/Descript.polish: Atmosfera przyprawia tu o dreszcze, jakby ktoś obserwował cię przez dziurkę od klucza...

Conversation/0x010000570001DA2D/Descript.english: A flamboyant poster of a white star. Real lithography.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA34/Descript.english: Photos of revolutionaries posing with guns.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA3B/Descript.english: Someone has drawn a five-pointed star on the wall.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA4A/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая скрыня поўная бытавой хіміі. Пахне пральным парашком.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA57/Descript.belarusian: Каробка са шматкамі. Здаецца, яны заплеснелі.

Conversation/0x010000570001DA62/Descript.english: Glossy erotica covers the wall, wrinkled from moisture.

Conversation/0x0100005700022958/Descript.english: The working class woman said that you're a bit of a cockatoo. What if it's true? Go read up on cockatoos in the bookstore, maybe you'll discover something new about yourself as well.

Conversation/0x0100005700022958/Descript.belarusian: Жанчына з рабочага класа сказала, што ты бы нейкі какаду. А калі гэта праўда? Ідзі ў кнігарню і пачытай пра какаду, можа, даведаешся таксама нешта новае пра сябе.

Conversation/0x0100005800005A06/Descript.english: Whoever lives here admires fair-haired fantasy heroes with big muscles.

Conversation/0x0100005800009EDC/Descript.english: This winch mechanism has been oxidizing for some years.

Conversation/0x010000580000BFF4/Descript.english: Old file folders in the cart, documents silvery with mould.

Conversation/0x010000580000C005/Descript.english: Revolutionary propaganda on the bunk bed: ancient flyers and brochures.

Conversation/0x010000580000C00B/Descript.english: Stale fabric smell and dust. No one's slept here in months, maybe years.

Conversation/0x010000580000DDA4/Descript.polish: To to samo okienko, które widziałeś z zewnątrz.
Conversation/0x010000580000DDA4/Descript.belarusian: Тое самае вузкае акенца, якое ты бачыў звонку.

Conversation/0x010000580001B63D/Descript.polish: Aż roi się tu od szarańczy!

Conversation/0x010000580001C27A/Descript.english: Lena gave you a commemorative pin to pawn when you were desperate for cash. The *honourable* thing to do would be to return it to her -- buy it back and return it to her once you have money.

Conversation/0x010000580001C280/Descript.english: Lena gave you a commemorative pin to pawn when you were desperate for cash. You could pay her back once your financial situation isn't quite as pitiful. Finished when you give Lena what the pawnbroker paid you for the pin.

Conversation/0x0100006400009DB1/Descript.english: Hardie and the boys know the whole story. It'll be difficult to get it out of him. Have you thoroughly inspected the body? Looked around for a witness? Gotten friendly with the Union boss and the company rep? *Really* gotten to Klaasje?

Conversation/0x0100006B00007CB4/Descript.english: Dolores Dei was fond of figurines. She deserves more. You should offer her any and all you have one day, if you meet her in person. What an odd task to give yourself -- but here we are.

Conversation/0x0100006B00007CB4/Descript.belarusian: Доларэс Дэй цаніла фігуркі. Заслугоўвае больш. Калі калі-небудзь сустрэнеш яе асабіста, павінен падарыць ёй усе, якія маеш. Ну і дзіўнае заданне ты сабе даў. Ну але калі так...

Conversation/0x0100006B0000A37A/Descript.english: You need to find the firearm that killed the hanged man. Something tells you it will take *some* time. You could start by identifying the bullet, so you'd know the weapon that shot it. After that, keep your eyes open. And be patient.
Conversation/0x0100006B0000A37A/Descript.polish: Musisz znaleźć broń, którą zabito wisielca. Coś ci mówi, że *trochę* to zajmie. Spróbuj zacząć od zidentyfikowania naboju, by dowiedzieć się chociaż, z czego został wystrzelony. Później zaś miej oczy szeroko otwarte. I uzbrój się w cierpliwość.
Conversation/0x0100006B0000A37A/Descript.belarusian: Ты павінен знайсці зброю, якой забілі вісельніка. Штосьці табе кажа, што гэта *трохі* зойме часу. Паспрабуй пачаць з ідэнтыфікацыі патрона, каб хоць даведацца, з чаго ён быў выпушчаны. Потым трымай вочы шырока адчыненымі. І ўзбройся ў цярпенне.

Perform an advanced analysis, using H/E Coordination.

Conversation/0x0100008900001A72/Descript.belarusian: Пахне потам і пральным парашком. І яшчэ ледзь чуваць эфір.

Conversation/0x0100008900001A84/Descript.english: Canisters filled with what appears to be water. The label says "Distilled."
Conversation/0x0100008900001A84/Descript.polish: Kanistry wypełnione czymś, co wygląda na wodę. Na etykiecie napisano „Destylowana”.
Conversation/0x0100008900001A84/Descript.belarusian: Каністры, напоўненыя чымсьці, што выглядае як вада. На этыкетцы напісана: "Дыстыляваная".

Conversation/0x0100008900001A8D/Descript.english: A pile of nasal sprays. Brand name: "Nosaphed Ultra."
Conversation/0x0100008900001A8D/Descript.polish: Stosik sprayów do nosa. Nazwa marki: „Nosafed Ultra”.
Conversation/0x0100008900001A8D/Descript.belarusian: Куча спрэяў для носа. Марка: "Назафед Ультра".

Conversation/0x0100008900002EB3/Descript.english: The tractor tire used in this makeshift dinghy has a hole in it.
Conversation/0x0100008900002EB3/Descript.polish: Użyta w tej prowizorycznej łodzi opona od traktora jest dziurawa.
Conversation/0x0100008900002EB3/Descript.belarusian: Трактарная шына ў гэтай самаробнай надзіманай лодцы — дзіравая.

Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/Descript.english: Go to it, carefully... it may be dangerous.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/Descript.polish: Podejdź, tylko ostrożnie... może być niebezpieczny.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/Descript.belarusian: Падыдзі бліжэй, толькі асцярожна... ён можа быць небяспечным.

Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.english: Approach the insect first -- get close to it.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.polish: Najpierw podejdź do insekta. Zbliż się do niego.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.belarusian: Спачатку падыдзі да казуркі — наблізься да яе.

Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.english: Investigate the insect until it's no longer there.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.belarusian: Вывучай казурку, пакуль яна не знікне.

Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.english: Phasmid's gone. Check up on the deserter now.
Conversation/0x0100008900002F4A/subtask_.polish: Straszyk zniknął. Teraz sprawdź, co z dezerterem.

Conversation/0x01000089000040DF/Descript.english: Something odd about this windowpane... Can't make out what from this side.
Conversation/0x01000089000040DF/Descript.polish: Coś jest dziwnego z tą witryną... Od tej strony nie da się stwierdzić, o co chodzi.
Conversation/0x01000089000040DF/Descript.belarusian: Нешта дзіўнае з гэтай шыбай... З гэтага боку не разабраць, што менавіта.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000EB5/Descript.english: The ad reads: "Broken Window? Tibbs has windows!"
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EB5/Descript.polish: Napis na reklamie głosi: „Zniszczone okna? Kupisz nowe u Tibbsa!”.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EB5/Descript.belarusian: На рэкламе напісана: "Выбітае акно? У Цібса ёсць вокны!".

Conversation/0x0100008F00000ED3/Descript.english: Etched into the wood, barely visible: *REMEMBER THE* ...the rest is lost to time.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000ED3/Descript.polish: W drewnie wyryto ledwie widoczny już napis: *PAMIĘTAJ O...*. Resztę zatarł czas.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000ED3/Descript.belarusian: Выразана на дрэве, ледзь прыкметна: *ПАМЯТАЙ ПРА*... астатнае сцёр час.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000EEC/Descript.english: Your room in the Whirling isn't much bigger than this sloop.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EEC/Descript.polish: Twój pokój w Whirling nie jest wiele większy od tej łodzi.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EEC/Descript.belarusian: Твой пакой у Whirling не нашмат большы за гэты шлюп.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000EF2/Descript.english: The sea breeze carries more than salt: meat. Not rotten, not fresh; grilled.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EF2/Descript.polish: Morska bryza niesie coś więcej niż sól: zapach mięsa. Nie zgniłego, nie świeżego. Grillowanego.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000EF2/Descript.belarusian: Марскі брыз прыносіць не толькі соль: яшчэ і пах мяса. Не гнілога, не свежага — смажанага на грылі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F1D/Descript.english: The lorries probably stored fuel here; now, they store booze.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F1D/Descript.polish: Trzymano tu zapewne paliwo do ciężarówek. Dziś jest tu gorzałka.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F1D/Descript.belarusian: У грузавіках тут, пэўна, захоўвалі паліва; цяпер у іх трымаюць бырла.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F35/Descript.english: Ruins full of snow. No one lives here anymore.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F35/Descript.polish: Zasypane śniegiem ruiny. Nikt już tu nie mieszka.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F35/Descript.belarusian: Засыпаныя снегам руіны. Тут больш ніхто не жыве.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F45/Descript.polish: Ze środka dobiega odgłos kroków. Nie człowieka.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F4B/Descript.english: A helpline to the company that controls the drawbridge.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F4B/Descript.polish: Linia łącząca z przedsiębiorstwem sterującym mostem zwodzonym.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F4B/Descript.belarusian: Гарачая лінія кампаніі, якая кіруе развадным мостам.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F51/Descript.english: Hot air rises up from the sewer: sour, acidic and strangely comforting.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F51/Descript.polish: Z kanałów unosi się gorące powietrze. Kwaśne i dziwnie kojące.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F51/Descript.belarusian: З каналізацыі падымаецца гарачае паветра: кіслае, з'едлівае і дзіўна суцяшальнае.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000F57/Descript.english: An ancient fountain. It doesn't pump water anymore. There's a tree in it.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F57/Descript.polish: Bardzo stara fontanna. Nie leci już z niej woda. Wyrasta z niej za to drzewo.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000F57/Descript.belarusian: Старажытны фантан. Вада з яго больш не цячэ. Затое ў ім расце дрэва.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000FAF/Descript.english: Only a dog and no more.

Conversation/0x0100008F00000FB5/Descript.english: Up there? The phasmid, perhaps? No... you know it's but a dog.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000FB5/Descript.polish: Tam, na górze? Może to straszyk? Nie... wiesz, że to tylko pies.
Conversation/0x0100008F00000FB5/Descript.belarusian: Там, наверсе? Можа, фазмід? Не... ты ведаеш, што гэта толькі сабака.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001167/Descript.english: This is worth more than you'll ever earn in all your life.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001167/Descript.polish: To jest warte więcej, niż zarobisz przez całe swoje życie.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001167/Descript.belarusian: Гэта каштуе больш, чым ты заробіш за ўсё сваё жыццё.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001170/Descript.english: A garden hose. This won't be of use until the snow melts.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001170/Descript.polish: Wąż ogrodowy. Nie przyda się na nic, dopóki nie stopnieje śnieg.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001170/Descript.belarusian: Садовы шланг. Ад яго не будзе карысці, пакуль не растане снег.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001176/Descript.english: Chairs and tables eaten by rain and rot.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001176/Descript.polish: Krzesła i stoły zniszczone przez deszcz i zgniliznę.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001176/Descript.belarusian: Крэслы і сталы, з'едзеныя дажджом і гніллю.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001185/Descript.english: A sewer grate: a gateway to the river of filth.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001185/Descript.polish: Krata ściekowa: brama do rzeki brudu.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001185/Descript.belarusian: Каналізацыйныя краты: брама ў раку бруду.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000119C/Descript.english: You shouldn't feel threatened by handsome men. Don't be silly.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000119C/Descript.polish: Nie powinieneś czuć lęku przed przystojniakami. Nie bądź gamoniem.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000119C/Descript.belarusian: Ты не павінен баяцца прыгажуноў. Не глупі.

Conversation/0x0100008F000011A4/Descript.english: JUMP JAMS! -- A populaire Musique Mag.

Conversation/0x0100008F000011AD/Descript.english: Empty, but for cigarette ash and the crumbs of fried foods.
Conversation/0x0100008F000011AD/Descript.polish: Nic tu nie ma poza popiołem papierosowym i okruszkami jedzenia.
Conversation/0x0100008F000011AD/Descript.belarusian: Пуста, калі не лічыць цыгарэтнага попелу і крошак смажаніны.

Conversation/0x0100008F000011BA/Descript.english: Inside, the frame of a motorcycle-in-repair and the tools used to disassemble it.
Conversation/0x0100008F000011BA/Descript.polish: W środku widać ramę naprawianego motocykla i narzędzia, które posłużyły do jego rozebrania.
Conversation/0x0100008F000011BA/Descript.belarusian: Унутры — рама матацыкла, які рамантуюць, і начынне, якім яго разбіралі.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000189C/Descript.english: Scribbled between the thighs of a page-three girl: *L’ORIGINE DU DISCO*
Conversation/0x0100008F0000189C/Descript.polish: Między udami dziewczyny na trzeciej stronie ktoś nabazgrał: „L’ORIGINE DU DISCO”.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000189C/Descript.belarusian: Між сцёгнаў дзяўчыны з трэцяй старонкі надрапана: *L’ORIGINE DU DISCO*

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B0D/Descript.english: A composite eye of halogen lights watches you, emitting a low buzz.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B0D/Descript.polish: Kompozytowe oko halogenowych świateł wpatruje się w ciebie, wydając niskie buczenie.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B0D/Descript.belarusian: Складанае вока галагенавых ліхтароў глядзіць на цябе, выдаючы нізкае гудзенне.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B13/Descript.english: A panel that controls the cranes reads "Éteindre," "Allumer."
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B13/Descript.polish: Panel sterujący żurawiami ma na sobie napis: „Éteindre”, „Allumer”.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B19/Descript.english: This speaker tower is silent. There is no work to organize in the yard below.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B19/Descript.polish: Wieża z głośnikami milczy. Na placu nie ma żadnej pracy do nadzorowania.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B19/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая вежа з дынамікамі маўчыць. На пляцоўцы ўнізе няма працы, якую трэба было б арганізоўваць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B1F/Descript.english: The shipyard ahead is oddly quiet. The great machines are sleeping.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B1F/Descript.polish: W stoczni panuje dziwna cisza. Wielkie maszyny śpią.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B1F/Descript.belarusian: Верф наперадзе дзіўна прыціхла. Вялізныя машыны спяць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B26/Descript.english: The musk of oil and rust comes from the chasm in front of you. Smells like blood.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B26/Descript.polish: Z dołu dobiega cię woń ropy i rdzy. Przywodzi na myśl krew.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B26/Descript.belarusian: Цяжкі пах мазуты і іржы даносіцца з прорвы перад табой. Пахне крывёй.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B33/Descript.english: Eviction notices and missing pets are plastered on top of each other.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B33/Descript.polish: Ponaklejane na siebie informacje o eksmisjach i zaginionych zwierzętach.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B33/Descript.belarusian: Паведамленні пра высяленне і аб'явы пра зніклых жывёл налепленыя адно на адно.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B39/Descript.english: The graffito says: "A firing squad for the rich."
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B39/Descript.belarusian: На графіці напісана: "Расстрэльны ўзвод для багатых".

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B41/Descript.english: The air stinks with something sour...
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B41/Descript.polish: W powietrzu czuć smród czegoś kwaśnego...
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B41/Descript.belarusian: У паветры стаіць смурод чагосьці кіслага...

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B4E/Descript.english: Could it be *the phasmid*? No… Probably not.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B4E/Descript.polish: Czy to może być *straszyk*? Nie... Raczej nie.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B54/Descript.english: Don't be ridiculous. You can hear it swarming with bugs.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B54/Descript.polish: Nie wygłupiaj się. Aż słyszysz rojące się w nim pluskwy.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B54/Descript.belarusian: Не дурней. Чутно, як там кішаць блашчыцы.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B5F/Descript.english: Someone's growing rosemary, thyme -- and a cactus.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B5F/Descript.polish: Ktoś hoduje rozmaryn, tymianek... i kaktusa.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B5F/Descript.belarusian: Хтосьці вырошчвае размарын, чабор — і кактус.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B65/Descript.english: The breaker box is full of cigarette butts and electric wires.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B65/Descript.polish: Skrzynka z bezpiecznikami jest pełna niedopałków i kabli.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B65/Descript.belarusian: Скрыня з засцерагальнікамі поўная акуркаў і электрычных дратоў.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B74/Descript.english: This is the door to apartment #29.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B80/Descript.english: The curtains shift. Just a little. Someone is watching from within.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B80/Descript.polish: Zasłonki poruszają się o włos. Ktoś obserwuje cię z wewnątrz.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B80/Descript.belarusian: Фіранкі зварухнуліся. Зусім крыху. Нехта сочыць знутры.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B90/Descript.english: Voices from within. Singing along to some buoyant dance track.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B90/Descript.polish: Ze środka dobiegają cię głosy. Śpiew w takt pogodnego podkładu dance'owego.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001B90/Descript.belarusian: Знутры даносяцца галасы. Падпяваюць нейкаму бадзёраму танцавальнаму трэку.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001B9A/Descript.english: This is the door to apartment #30.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BAC/Descript.english: Above, tarps flap in the wind. Forgotten hammers and nails rust.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BAC/Descript.polish: Brezent łopocze wysoko na wietrze. Rdzewieją zapomniane młotki i gwoździe.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BAC/Descript.belarusian: Угары брызент лопае на ветры. Ржавеюць забытыя малаткі і цвікі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BB9/Descript.english: The door is locked. You can't get in.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BB9/Descript.polish: Drzwi są zamknięte. Nie masz jak wejść.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BBF/Descript.english: The chair's new. Someone lives back here.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BBF/Descript.polish: Krzesło jest nowe. Ktoś tutaj mieszka.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE2/Descript.english: Enough coal to last for several winters. Smells of chemicals.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE2/Descript.polish: Dość węgla, by starczyło na kilka zim. Czuć go chemikaliami.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE2/Descript.belarusian: Дастаткова вугалю на некалькі зім. Пахне хімікатамі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE8/Descript.english: A hundred tiny feet scurrying beneath the grate. The rats of the city.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE8/Descript.polish: Pod kratką słychać tupot setek maleńkich łapek. Miejskie szczury.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BE8/Descript.belarusian: Сотні маленечкіх лапак шныраць пад кратамі. Гарадскія пацукі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001BFA/Descript.english: Fire! Suddenly you feel the box is on *fire*... why?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BFA/Descript.polish: Ogień! Czujesz nagle, że pudełko *płonie*... Ale czemu?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001BFA/Descript.belarusian: Агонь! Раптам ты адчуваеш, што скрынка *гарыць*... чаму?

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C10/Descript.english: Someone has left their music collection beneath the tarpaulin.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C10/Descript.polish: Ktoś zostawił pod plandeką swoją kolekcję muzyki.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C10/Descript.belarusian: Нехта пакінуў пад брызентам сваю калекцыю музыкі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C16/Descript.english: Someone has broken down the fence *and* the barbed wire.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C1C/Descript.english: There's a boat tucked away underneath the tarpaulin cover.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C22/Descript.english: Traffic beyond the gate. More abandoned motor lorries.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C22/Descript.polish: Ruch uliczny za bramą. Kolejne porzucone ciężarówki motorowe.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C22/Descript.belarusian: Дарожны рух за брамай. Чарговыя пакінутыя грузавікі.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C28/Descript.english: The ice just off the coast crackles, shifting.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C28/Descript.polish: Niedaleko brzegu lód pęka i przesuwa się.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C28/Descript.belarusian: Лёд ля самага берага патрэсквае, ссоўваецца.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C49/Descript.english: Through the broken glass: dusty shelves and a forgotten chair.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C49/Descript.polish: Za rozbitą szybą widać zakurzone półki i zapomniane krzesło.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C49/Descript.belarusian: За разбітым шклом: запыленыя паліцы і забытае крэсла.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C4F/Descript.english: Sounds of life in the north. A washboard scrubs filth from fabric.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C4F/Descript.polish: Z północy dobiegają odgłosy życia. Ktoś trze brudną tkaniną o tarę.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C4F/Descript.belarusian: Гукі жыцця на поўначы. Пральная дошка сцірае бруд з тканіны.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C55/Descript.english: This boat is floating freely in the water, unmoored.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C55/Descript.polish: Niezacumowana łódź unosi się swobodnie na wodzie.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C55/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая лодка свабодна гайдаецца на вадзе, непрывязаная.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C5B/Descript.english: Cinderblocks, charred. A makeshift firepit with magazines for lighting.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C5B/Descript.polish: Pokryte popiołem pustaki. Prowizoryczne palenisko z czasopismami na rozpałkę.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C5B/Descript.belarusian: Абвугленыя шлакаблокі. Самаробнае вогнішча з часопісамі для распальвання.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C6C/Descript.english: Looking back at you from the rust coloured water: you.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C6C/Descript.polish: Spod powierzchni rdzawej wody spoglądasz na siebie ty sam.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C6C/Descript.belarusian: З іржавай вады на цябе глядзіш ты сам.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C7E/Descript.polish: Przeżarte rdzą litery układają się w słowo MAZUT.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C8A/Descript.english: The boathouse is shoddily constructed. A strong breeze might blow it over.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C8A/Descript.polish: Szopa na łodzie jest bardzo prowizoryczna. Mocniejszy powiew może ją przewrócić.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C8A/Descript.belarusian: Лодачны хлеў злеплены абы-як. Мацнейшы парыў ветру можа яго заваліць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C90/Descript.english: The water runs from the west. The source is upstream. A broken pipe?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C90/Descript.polish: Woda płynie z zachodu. Jej źródło jest gdzieś u góry biegu. Pęknięta rura?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C90/Descript.belarusian: Вада цячэ з захаду. Крыніца вышэй па плыні. Прабітая труба?

Conversation/0x0100008F00001C9C/Descript.english: A school of fish huddle around the fence post. Then scatter into the dark.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C9C/Descript.polish: Ławica ryb skupia się na chwilę wokół słupa płotu, po czym umyka w mrok.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001C9C/Descript.belarusian: Касяк рыбы туліцца вакол слупа ад плота. А пасля расплываецца ў цемру.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA2/Descript.english: Maybe a way underground? Maybe she’s down there?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA2/Descript.polish: Może to zejście pod ziemię? Może ona jest tam, na dole?
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA2/Descript.belarusian: Можа, гэта ход пад зямлю? Можа, яна там, унізе?

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA8/Descript.english: Full of holes. Could the posts hide... treasure? Look inside.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA8/Descript.polish: Mnóstwo dziur. Czyżby w słupach krył się... skarb? Zajrzyj do środka.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CA8/Descript.belarusian: Поўна дзірак. Ці не хаваецца ў слупах... скарб? Зазірні ўсярэдзіну.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CAE/Descript.english: Could the Instigator be hiding in the boathouse? No… that’d be too easy.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CAE/Descript.polish: Czyżby podżegaczka ukrywała się w szopie? Nie. To byłoby zbyt łatwe.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CAE/Descript.belarusian: Ці можа Падбухторшчыца хавацца ў лодачным хляве? Не… гэта было б занадта проста.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CB4/Descript.english: There's a slit in the concrete here... a sewer?

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CDA/Descript.english: That tarp will keep out neither rain, nor snow, nor wind.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CDA/Descript.polish: Tarp nie przepuszcza ni deszczu, ni śniegu, ni wiatru.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CDA/Descript.belarusian: Гэты брызент не абароніць ні ад дажджу, ні ад снегу, ні ад ветру.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE0/Descript.english: A makeshift roof. Vagrants have tried to make the boardwalk habitable.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE0/Descript.polish: Prowizoryczny dach. Włóczędzy próbowali zrobić sobie z promenady dom.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE0/Descript.belarusian: Самаробны дах. Валацугі спрабавалі зрабіць праменад прыдатным для жыцця.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE6/Descript.english: A coin operated weighing machine. Hasn't been used for a decade.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE6/Descript.polish: Waga na monety. Nikt jej nie używał co najmniej z dziesięć lat.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CE6/Descript.belarusian: Манетныя вагі. Імі не карысталіся ўжо гадоў дзесяць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CEF/Descript.english: Dusty pews in the shadows. Many seem to be missing.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CEF/Descript.polish: Zakurzone ławy giną w mroku. Wielu chyba brakuje.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CEF/Descript.belarusian: Запыленыя лавы ў ценю. Здаецца, многіх не хапае.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CF5/Descript.english: An altar shrouded in dark. Or something like that – it’s too dark to tell.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CF5/Descript.polish: Pogrążony w ciemnościach ołtarz. Albo coś podobnego – w mroku nie sposób stwierdzić.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CF5/Descript.belarusian: Агорнуты цемрай алтар. Ці нешта накшталт таго — занадта цёмна, каб разабраць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001CFB/Descript.english: It must have taken a lot of patience to do this.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CFB/Descript.polish: Zrobienie czegoś takiego musiało wymagać nie lada cierpliwości.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001CFB/Descript.belarusian: Каб зрабіць такое, спатрэбілася багата цярплівасці.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D01/Descript.english: From up there, one would have a great view of the ice floes out back.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D01/Descript.polish: Z góry musi być wspaniały widok na krę lodową na tyłach.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D01/Descript.belarusian: Адтуль зверху адкрываўся б цудоўны від на крыгі ззаду.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D07/Descript.english: Yellow moss on these stones... They're probably stolen from someone's garden.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D07/Descript.polish: Żółty mech na kamieniach... Pewnie wykradziono je z czyjegoś ogrodu.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D07/Descript.belarusian: Жоўты мох на гэтых камянях... Напэўна, іх сцягнулі з чыйгосьці саду.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D0D/Descript.english: Painted with pastels. Someone is trying to bring cheer into the world.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D0D/Descript.polish: Pomalowany pastelami. Ktoś próbuje tchnąć w świat nieco radości.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D0D/Descript.belarusian: Размалявана пастэллю. Хтосьці спрабуе прыўнесці ў свет радасць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D13/Descript.english: This barrel has been recently discarded. It still smells of fuel oil.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D13/Descript.polish: Beczka została wyrzucona niedawno. Wciąż czuć z niej paliwem.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D13/Descript.belarusian: Гэтую бочку выкінулі зусім нядаўна. Ад яе ўсё яшчэ пахне мазутам.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D19/Descript.english: A dead phone. A smashed receiver; like someone hung up too hard.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D19/Descript.polish: Głuchy telefon. Zniszczona słuchawka. Jakby ktoś zbyt gwałtownie ją odłożył.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D19/Descript.belarusian: Мёртвы тэлефон. Разбітая слухаўка — нібыта нехта шпурнуў яе з усяе сілы.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D1F/Descript.english: Buzz. Hum. The electricity flows through the wires with audible power.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D1F/Descript.polish: Brzęczenie. Szum. Płynąca w przewodach elektryczność daje znak swojej obecności.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D1F/Descript.belarusian: Жужанне. Гудзенне. Электрычнасць бяжыць па правадах з чутнай моцай.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D25/Descript.english: White curtains have been drawn shut. No looking in.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D25/Descript.polish: Białe zasłonki są szczelnie zaciągnięte. Nie zajrzysz do środka.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D25/Descript.belarusian: Белыя фіранкі шчыльна запнутыя. Усярэдзіну не зазірнуць.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D2B/Descript.english: The beams are splintered. The bridge didn't collapse on its own. Artillery broke it.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D2B/Descript.polish: Wsporniki są w drzazgach. Ten most nie zawalił się sam. Zniszczyła go artyleria.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D2B/Descript.belarusian: Бэлькі растрошчаныя. Мост абваліўся не сам. Яго разбіла артылерыя.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D31/Descript.english: A door. A building. A hiding place. Could the Instigator be inside?!
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D31/Descript.polish: Drzwi. Budynek. Kryjówka. Czy podżegaczka może być w środku?!
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D31/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы. Будынак. Сховішча. Ці можа Падбухторшчыца быць усярэдзіне?!

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D5B/Descript.english: Construction material. Whoever planned to build this house left in a hurry.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D5B/Descript.polish: Materiał budowlany. Ktokolwiek zamierzał zbudować ten dom, wyniósł się w pośpiechu.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D5B/Descript.belarusian: Будаўнічыя матэрыялы. Хто б ні збіраўся будаваць гэты дом, з'ехаў у спешцы.

Conversation/0x0100008F00001D67/Descript.english: The ice bobs up and down, creaking as it rubs against adjacent ice.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D67/Descript.polish: Lód buja się w górę i w dół, skrzypiąc w kontakcie z krą wokoło.
Conversation/0x0100008F00001D67/Descript.belarusian: Лёд пагойдваецца ўверх і ўніз, рыпучы ад трэння аб суседнія крыгі.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000211F/Descript.english: There is a seagull flying somewhere along the coast. The area there should have an afterthought orbital.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000211F/Descript.polish: Gdzieś wzdłuż wybrzeża leci mewa. Okolica powinna prowokować jakąś myśl do krążenia ci wokół głowy.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000211F/Descript.belarusian: Недзе ўздоўж узбярэжжа ляціць кірля. У гэтай мясціне павінна быць думка-арбіталь.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000259D/Descript.english: A foreign car. Kept in good condition.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002A01/Descript.english: These heavy military blockades are riddled with bullet holes, crumbling.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002A01/Descript.polish: Pełne śladów po nabojach masywne blokady wojskowe. Powoli się sypią.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002A01/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя цяжкія вайсковыя загароды зрэшачаныя кулямі і асыпаюцца.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CB4/Descript.english: To protect boats coming in? But who comes here anymore...
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CB4/Descript.polish: Do ochrony przypływających łodzi? Ale kto się tu jeszcze w ogóle zjawia...?
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CB4/Descript.belarusian: Каб абараняць лодкі, што прыбываюць? Але хто сюды ўвогуле яшчэ прыплывае...

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CBA/Descript.english: It must have been a direct hit to take out such a huge chunk.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CBA/Descript.polish: Oderwanie tak wielkiego kawału musiało wymagać bezpośredniego trafienia.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CBA/Descript.belarusian: Каб вырваць такі вялізны кавалак, спатрэбілася прамое пападанне.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CC6/Descript.english: A makeshift bridge. The bombs were powerful enough to break the foundation.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CC6/Descript.polish: Prowizoryczny most. Bomby miały dość siły, żeby rozbić podpory.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CC6/Descript.belarusian: Самаробны мост. Бомбы былі дастаткова магутныя, каб разбурыць падмурак.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CCC/Descript.english: No guard rails... you look down. This is a safety hazard.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CCC/Descript.polish: Brak balustrady... Spoglądasz w dół. Nie jest to bezpieczne.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CCC/Descript.belarusian: Ніякіх агароджаў... ты глядзіш уніз. Гэта пагроза бяспецы.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CE4/Descript.english: There's a lingering trace of mazut in the air.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CE4/Descript.polish: W powietrzu unosi się zapach mazutu.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CE4/Descript.belarusian: У паветры ўсё яшчэ лунае пах мазуту.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CF6/Descript.english: No way to get up there. The stairs are gone
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CF6/Descript.polish: Nie ma jak tam wejść. Schody przestały istnieć.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CF6/Descript.belarusian: Няма як туды падняцца. Сходаў больш няма

Conversation/0x0100008F00002CFC/Descript.english: The inside of the fortress... You make out the console and the blast door.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CFC/Descript.polish: Wnętrze fortecy... Widzisz konsolę i potężne wrota.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002CFC/Descript.belarusian: Унутры фартэцыі... Ты бачыш кансоль і браняваныя дзверы.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002D0D/Descript.english: When the wheel moves, the massive machine must move with it.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D0D/Descript.polish: Ogromna maszyna musi poruszać się wraz z tym kołem.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D0D/Descript.belarusian: Калі кола рухаецца, масіўная машына мусіць рухацца разам з ім.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002D19/Descript.english: Dishes stained with sauce and fire. A survivor's kitchen.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D19/Descript.polish: Naczynia noszące ślady sosu i ognia. Kuchnia ocalałego.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D19/Descript.belarusian: Посуд са слядамі соўсу і агню. Кухня ацалелага.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002D31/Descript.english: A waterlogged book. The pages are drying, but it'll be illegible forever now.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D31/Descript.polish: Zamoknięta książka. Stronice powoli schną, ale pozostanie nieczytelna na zawsze.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D31/Descript.belarusian: Размаклая кніга. Старонкі сохнуць, але яна ўжо назаўжды застанецца нечытэльнай.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002D3E/Descript.english: A specialized telescope. Helps mark the distance to faraway targets.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D3E/Descript.polish: Specjalistyczny teleskop. Pomaga określić odległość od dalekich punktów.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D3E/Descript.belarusian: Спецыялізаваны тэлескоп. Дапамагае вызначыць адлегласць да далёкіх цэляў.

Conversation/0x0100008F00002D6B/Descript.english: The reeds sway strangely... No, it's nothing.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D6B/Descript.polish: Trzcina kołysze się jakoś dziwnie... Choć nie, to jednak nic takiego.
Conversation/0x0100008F00002D6B/Descript.belarusian: Трыснёг хістаецца неяк дзіўна... Не, здалося.

Conversation/0x0100008F00003409/Descript.english: The pain in your pelvis makes you wince. Then you continue.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003409/Descript.polish: Ból w podbrzuszu wykrzywia twoją twarz w grymasie. Po chwili ruszasz dalej.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003409/Descript.belarusian: Боль у тазе прымушае цябе скрывіцца. Потым ты ідзеш далей.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000340F/Descript.english: The ice cracks under your feet. Be careful not to fall through...
Conversation/0x0100008F0000340F/Descript.polish: Lód trzeszczy ci pod stopami. Uważaj, żeby się nie załamał...
Conversation/0x0100008F0000340F/Descript.belarusian: Лёд трашчыць пад нагамі. Асцярожна, каб не праваліцца...

Conversation/0x0100008F00003415/Descript.english: Small bell-shaped flowers are blossoming in the sand. The snow must be weaker.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003415/Descript.polish: Małe kwiatki w kształcie dzwonków kwitną wśród piasku. Śnieg musi być tu cieńszy.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003415/Descript.belarusian: Дробныя кветкі ў форме званочкаў цвітуць на пяску. Снег тут, відаць, танчэйшы.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000341B/Descript.english: Flowers growing out of the sand, from under the snow. Winter's over soon!
Conversation/0x0100008F0000341B/Descript.polish: Na piasku, spod śniegu, wyrastają kwiaty. Niedługo koniec zimy!
Conversation/0x0100008F0000341B/Descript.belarusian: Кветкі растуць на пяску, з-пад снегу. Хутка канец зіме!

Conversation/0x0100008F00003421/Descript.english: There are flowers here already in bloom. Winter will be over soon.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003421/Descript.polish: Widać tu już kwitnące kwiaty. Zima niedługo się skończy.
Conversation/0x0100008F00003421/Descript.belarusian: Тут ужо цвітуць кветкі. Зіма хутка скончыцца.

Conversation/0x0100008F0000342C/Descript.english: The air smells sweet. And scary, somehow.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000342C/Descript.polish: Powietrze wydaje się słodkie. I dziwnie przerażające.
Conversation/0x0100008F0000342C/Descript.belarusian: Паветра пахне салодка. І неяк жудасна.

Conversation/0x0100008F00003437/Descript.english: The smell of the sea fills the air.

Conversation/0x0100008F000038F0/Descript.english: You refused the tape Hardie offered you, wherein the hanged man supposedly testified his intent to rape and pillage. Does Klaasje know anything about the recording? You should ask her -- unless you like loose ends.
Conversation/0x0100008F000038F0/Descript.polish: Nie przyjąłeś taśmy, którą chciał ci dać Hardie, a na której wisielec rzekomo przyznaje się do zamiaru gwałtu i rabunku. Czy Klaasje wie coś o tym nagraniu? Powinieneś ją spytać. Chyba że lubisz mieć niedomknięte sprawy.
Conversation/0x0100008F000038F0/Descript.belarusian: Ты адмовіўся ад стужкі, якую прапаноўваў Хардзі, дзе павешаны нібыта пацвердзіў свой намер гвалтаваць і рабаваць. Ці ведае Клаас'е што-небудзь пра гэты запіс? Табе варта распытаць яе — калі толькі табе не падабаюцца нявырашаныя справы.

Conversation/0x0100009200000077/Descript.english: The snoring is... scary somehow. You should leave.
Conversation/0x0100009200000077/Descript.polish: Chrapanie jest jakieś... przerażające. Lepiej stąd iść.

Conversation/0x01000092000000A5/Descript.english: The cleaning lady said the apartment should be empty, but there's definitely someone inside. Could it be *counterculture people*? Investigate and report back to the cleaning lady in the apartment building's hallway.
Conversation/0x01000092000000A5/Descript.polish: Sprzątaczka mówiła, że mieszkanie powinno być puste, ktoś jednak ewidentnie jest w środku. Czyżby *członkowie kontrkultury*? Przyjrzyj się sprawie i poinformuj sprzątaczkę w holu apartamentowca.
Conversation/0x01000092000000A5/Descript.belarusian: Прыбірачка казала, што кватэра павінна быць пустая, але ўнутры дакладна нехта ёсць. Няўжо *прадстаўнікі контркультуры*? Разбярыся і паведамі прыбірачцы ў калідоры жылога дома.

Conversation/0x01000092000000A5/Title.english: Investigate apartment #10 for the cleaning lady
Conversation/0x01000092000000A5/Title.polish: Sprawdź dla sprzątaczki, co dzieje się w lokalu nr 10

Conversation/0x01000092000032FA/Descript.english: Some leftovers kept warm on a stove top.
Conversation/0x01000092000032FA/Descript.polish: Resztki jedzenia grzejące się na kuchence.

Conversation/0x0100009200003301/Descript.english: Fake house plants made of plastic.

Conversation/0x0100009200003308/Descript.english: Smells like buckwheat and onions here.

Conversation/0x010000920000330F/Descript.english: Windows covered in old newspaper clippings.
Conversation/0x010000920000330F/Descript.polish: Okna pokryte wycinkami ze starych gazet.
Conversation/0x010000920000330F/Descript.belarusian: Вокны заклееныя выразкамі са старых газет.

Conversation/0x010000920000331D/Descript.english: A textbook for high school. Mathematics. Trigonometry mostly.
Conversation/0x010000920000331D/Descript.belarusian: Падручнік для старэйшых класаў. Матэматыка. У асноўным трыганаметрыя.

Conversation/0x0100009200003324/Descript.english: Posters of contemporary pop stars adorn the walls.
Conversation/0x0100009200003324/Descript.polish: Ściany przyozdobione są plakatami współczesnych gwiazd popu.

Conversation/0x010000920000332B/Descript.english: Someone here is an avid reader of science fiction.
Conversation/0x010000920000332B/Descript.polish: Ktoś jest tu zapalonym czytelnikiem science-fiction.
Conversation/0x010000920000332B/Descript.belarusian: Хтосьці тут заўзяты чытач навуковай фантастыкі.

Conversation/0x010000920000334B/Descript.english: An empty pack of Red Astra cigarettes hidden under the bed.
Conversation/0x010000920000334B/Descript.polish: Ukryta pod łóżkiem pusta paczka papierosów Red Astra.
Conversation/0x010000920000334B/Descript.belarusian: Схаваны пад ложкам пусты пачак цыгарэт Чырвоная Астра.

Conversation/0x01000092000036F0/Descript.english: Get in front of Kineema's headlights to read the halogen watermarks in your ledger. This may yield some information about who you are.
Conversation/0x01000092000036F0/Descript.polish: Stań w świetle reflektorów kineemy, żeby odczytać halogenowe znaki wodne w swoim notatniku. Może dowiesz się dzięki temu, kim jesteś.

Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/Descript.english: You need to buy yourself more time to find whatever you're missing in the corpse. A fridge would allow you to preserve the body longer. Ask the Whirling, Frittte, or maybe Cuno, or some other local kids?

Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/Descript.belarusian: Забяспеч сябе большым часам, каб дакладней агледзець цела. Лядоўня дазволіла бы захаваць яго надаўжэй. Спытай у Whirling або Frittte. А можа таксама ў Куно або іншых мясцовых дзяцей?

Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/subtask_.english: Check out the fridge in the commercial building across from the Whirling.
Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/subtask_.polish: Przyjrzyj się lodówce w budynku handlowym naprzeciwko Whirling.
Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/subtask_.belarusian: Паглядзі на лядоўню у гандлёвым будынку насупраць Whirling.

Get Kim to help you move the body.

Conversation/0x01000095000000B0/subtask_.belarusian: Пераканай Кіма дапамагчы табе перанесці цела.

Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/Descript.english: The ageing cryptozoologist has been out in the reeds for too long, and his wife, Lena, is very worried. Maybe you can find him when you happen to be on the coast?
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/Descript.polish: Starzejący się kryptozoolog za długo już siedzi w trzcinach – jego żona, Lena, bardzo się martwi. Może zdołasz go znaleźć, kiedy trafisz na wybrzeże?
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/Descript.belarusian: Стары крыптазаолаг занадта доўга сядзіць у чаротах — яго жонка Лена вельмі хвалюецца. Можа, зможаш яго знайсці, калі патрапіш на ўзбярэжжа?

Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.english: Lena wants to know what happened to Morell. He set off south-west, across the canal. Start by going there.
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.polish: Lena chce wiedzieć, co stało się z Morellem. Wyruszył na południowy zachód, na drugą stronę kanału. Tam rozpocznij poszukiwania.
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.belarusian: Лена хоча ведаць, што сталася з Марэлем. Ён выправіўся на паўднёвы захад, цераз канал. Пачні пошукі адтуль.

Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.english: Tell Lena Morell is missing because of the broken water lock.

Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.english: You told Lena Morell is missing because of the broken waterlock. She is still worried he hasn't come back -- let Morell know if you see him.
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.polish: Powiedziałeś Lenie, że Morell nie wraca przez zepsutą śluzę wodną. Mimo to martwi się ona jego nieobecnością. Powiedz mu o tym, jeśli go spotkasz.
Conversation/0x01000095000000E9/subtask_.belarusian: Ты сказаў Лене, што Марэль не вяртаецца праз зламаны шлюз. Яна ўсё адно хвалюецца, што той дагэтуль не вярнуўся — перадай Марэлю, калі пабачыш яго.

Conversation/0x010000950000013B/Title.english: Determine where the shot came from

Conversation/0x0100009500000141/Descript.english: Enter flat #12 in the Capeside apartment building and get Cuno's speed. Sharing it with him will cement your friendship. And who knows what secrets it will lead to?
Conversation/0x0100009500000141/Descript.polish: Wejdź do mieszkania nr 12 w Apartamentowcu Półwysep i zdobądź speed dla Cuna. Dzieląc się z nim, umocnisz waszą przyjaźń. Kto wie, jakie odkryje ona przed tobą tajemnice?
Conversation/0x0100009500000141/Descript.belarusian: Увайдзі ў кватэру №12 у апарт-комплексе "Кейпсайд" і забяры спіды Куна. Калі падзелішся з ім, гэта ўмацуе вашу дружбу. І хто ведае, да якіх таямніц гэта прывядзе?

Conversation/0x0100009500000141/subtask_.polish: Zgłoś się z powrotem do Cuna.

Conversation/0x0100009500000141/subtask_.english: Try opening the door to Cuno's apartment again.

Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/Descript.english: Soona will cooperate with the ravers' nightclub plan... if you help her out with the research project first. Find the filament memory with an off-site copy from her old workplace and bring it back to her, then wait for further instructions. If you run into any problems you can always ask for Soona's help.
Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/Descript.polish: Soona pójdzie na współpracę w sprawie klubu raversów, jeśli pomożesz jej najpierw z jej projektem badawczym. Znajdź pamięć włosowatą z kopią danych z jej dawnego miejsca pracy i przynieś ją, po czym czekaj na dalsze instrukcje. Jeśli natkniesz się na kłopoty, możesz zawsze poprosić Soonę o pomoc.
Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/Descript.belarusian: Суна пагодзіцца на супрацоўніцтва ў справе начнога клуба рэйвераў... калі ты спачатку дапаможаш ёй з даследчым праектам. Знайдзі валаконны куб памяці з вонкавай копіяй з яе колішняга месца працы і прынясі яго ёй, а потым чакай далейшых інструкцый. Калі ўзнікнуць праблемы, заўсёды можаш звярнуцца да Суны па дапамогу.

Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/subtask_.english: Find the giant ice bear fridge in Doomed Commercial Area.
Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/subtask_.polish: Znajdź wielką lodówkę lodowego niedźwiedzia w Zgubionej Strefie Handlowej

Conversation/0x01000095000001FD/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі замерзлую машыну для марозіва, пра якую гаворыцца ў нататцы.

Conversation/0x010000950000021C/Descript.english: You can feel it -- this music could hit so much harder. It just needs a few tweaks... Walk back to the canal and see if you can find any tapes that could work as a melody, then bring them back to Egg Head for remixing.
Conversation/0x010000950000021C/Descript.polish: Czujesz to – muzyka mogłaby oddziaływać o wiele mocniej. Potrzeba tylko kilku poprawek... Wróć do kanału i spróbuj znaleźć taśmy, które posłużyłyby za melodię, po czym wróć do Jajkogłowca, żeby mógł je zmiksować.
Conversation/0x010000950000021C/Descript.belarusian: Ты гэта адчуваеш — гэтая музыка магла б качаць куды мацней. Трэба толькі пару правак... Вярніся да канала і паглядзі, ці знойдзеш стужкі, якія падыдуць пад мелодыю, а потым прынясі іх Яйкагаловаму на рэмікс.

Conversation/0x010000950000024C/Descript.english: In order to succeed 1) the body has to be down, 2) autopsy has to be finished, 3) and Kim has to be absent (he wouldn't approve). This will be *devilishly* tricky, so don't beat yourself up if you manage to send the body to the processing without getting hold of the boots.
Conversation/0x010000950000024C/Descript.polish: Aby ci się to udało: 1) ciało musi być na ziemi, 2) sekcja zwłok musi być zakończona, 3) Kim musi być nieobecny (nie pochwaliłby tego). To *diabelsko* trudne, więc nie złość się na siebie, jeśli odeślesz ciało do kostnicy, nie zdobywając tych butów.
Conversation/0x010000950000024C/Descript.belarusian: Каб усё атрымалася: 1) цела мусіць быць знятае, 2) аўтапсія павінна быць завершана, 3) і побач не павінна быць Кіма (ён бы гэтага не ўхваліў). Гэта будзе *па-д'ябальску* складана, таму не дакарай сябе, калі адправіш цела ў морг, так і не разжыўшыся ботамі.

Conversation/0x010000950000024C/subtask_.english: Wash the boots -- in a kitchen somewhere.

Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/Descript.polish: Na tarasie budynku mieszkalnego na północ od Martinaise spotkałeś tajemniczego nieznajomego. Wie on coś o morderstwie. Dowiedz się, gdzie mieszka, i przesłuchaj go ponownie.
Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/Descript.belarusian: Ты сустрэў таямнічага незнаёмца, які курыў на балконе жылога дома на поўначы Марцінэза. Ён ведае нешта пра забойства. Даведайся, дзе ён жыве, і дапытай яго зноў.

Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/subtask_.english: Find a way inside the large apartment building in the north.
Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/subtask_.polish: Znajdź wejście do dużego apartamentowca na północy.
Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі спосаб патрапіць у вялікі жылы дом на поўначы.

Locate the door #28 in the apt building.

Conversation/0x01000097000000AF/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі дзверы кватэры №28 у жылым доме.

Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Descript.english: Someone's been running around with your sidearm pretending to be a police officer. You must meet her near the old fish market at 22:00 and get your service weapon back. Just walk past the fishing village until you see the boardwalk.
Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Descript.polish: Ktoś łazi po okolicy z twoją bronią i podaje się za funkcjonariuszkę policji. Musisz spotkać się z nią przy starym targu rybnym o 22:00 i odzyskać swój służbowy pistolet. Miń wioskę rybacką i idź, póki nie zobaczysz promenady.
Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Descript.belarusian: Нехта бегае з тваім пісталетам і выдае сябе за супрацоўніцу паліцыі. Ты мусіш сустрэцца з ёй каля старога рыбнага рынку а 22:00 і вярнуць сваю табельную зброю. Проста міні рыбацкую вёску і ідзі, пакуль не ўбачыш праменад.

Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Title.english: Confront the Pigs and get your gun back
Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Title.polish: Spotkaj się ze Świniarką i odzyskaj swoją broń
Conversation/0x01000097000000DC/Title.belarusian: Сустрэнься з Мусарняй і вярні свой пісталет

Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/Descript.english: Someone must know something about your lost firearm. Maybe a district authority, like someone high up in the Union? Or someone local, who saw you with it before you passed out -- the Whirling's absent bartender? You could also ask the local pawnshop.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/Descript.polish: Ktoś musi wiedzieć coś o twojej zaginionej broni. Może ktoś ważny w dystrykcie, na przykład wysoko postawiona osoba w Związku? Albo ktoś miejscowy, kto cię z nią widział, zanim straciłeś przytomność. Nieobecna barmanka z Whirling? Możesz spytać też w miejscowym lombardzie.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/Descript.belarusian: Хтосьці мусіць ведаць хоць нешта пра тваю згубленую зброю. Магчыма, нехта з раённага кіраўніцтва, напрыклад, высокапастаўленая асоба ў Прафсаюзе? Ці нехта мясцовы, хто бачыў цябе з ёй, перш чым ты страціў прытомнасць, — адсутная бармэнка з Whirling? Можаш таксама спытаць у мясцовым ламбардзе.

Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.english: Find any information you can on the gun.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź wszelkie możliwe informacje o swojej broni.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі ўсю магчымую інфармацыю пра пісталет.

Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.english: Keep looking. Maybe someone else knows something.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.polish: Szukaj dalej. Może ktoś inny coś wie.
Conversation/0x01000097000000E9/subtask_.belarusian: Шукай далей. Магчыма, нехта іншы штосьці ведае.

Conversation/0x0100009700003CD6/Descript.english: Something looked off about the game the old men are playing on the plaza -- one of them (Gaston?) was cheating. Cheating in sports in unacceptable. Address this!
Conversation/0x0100009700003CD6/Descript.polish: Coś było nie tak z rozgrywką starszych panów na placu. Jeden z nich (Gaston?) oszukiwał. Oszustwa są w sporcie niedopuszczalne. Zrób coś z tym!
Conversation/0x0100009700003CD6/Descript.belarusian: Нешта было не так з гульнёй дзядкоў на пляцы — адзін з іх (Гастон?) махляваў. Махлярства ў спорце недапушчальнае. Разбярыся з гэтым!

Conversation/0x0100000400010F64/subtask_.english: Use fuel oil to paint the wall.
Conversation/0x0100000400010F64/subtask_.belarusian: Выкарыстай дызельнае паліва, каб пафарбаваць сцяну.

Conversation/0x0100000400011A30/Descript.english: There's a locked trash container behind the Whirling-in-Rags. The manager, Garte, should have a key. Alternatively, you could use brute force to pry the lid open. You just need a prybar.
Conversation/0x0100000400011A30/Descript.polish: Za Whirling-in-Rags stoi zamknięty pojemnik na śmieci. Kierownik, Garte, powinien mieć klucz. Możesz też użyć brutalnej siły, żeby otworzyć pokrywę. Potrzebny ci tylko łom.
Conversation/0x0100000400011A30/Descript.belarusian: За Whirling-in-Rags стаіць замкнёны смеццевы кантэйнер. У кіраўніка, Гарта, павінен быць ключ. У якасці альтэрнатывы ты можаш ужыць грубую сілу, каб адціснуць вечка. Табе спатрэбіцца толькі лом.

Conversation/0x0100000400011B2C/Descript.english: Find the representative of the logistics company who owns the harbour, and ask her about the murder. She should be around here somewhere...
Conversation/0x0100000400011B2C/Descript.polish: Znajdź przedstawicielkę firmy logistycznej będącej właścicielem portu i wypytaj ją o sprawę morderstwa. Powinna być gdzieś niedaleko...
Conversation/0x0100000400011B2C/Descript.belarusian: Знайдзі прадстаўніцу лагістычнай кампаніі, якая валодае портам, і распытай яе пра забойства. Яна павінна быць недзе тут паблізу...

Conversation/0x0100000400011B34/Descript.english: Enter the harbour and seek an audience with the local Débardeur's Union leader, Evrart Claire -- you need to ask him about the murder in his District.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B34/Descript.polish: Wejdź do portu i poproś o spotkanie z przywódcą miejscowego Związku Débardeurów, Evrartem Claire'em. Musisz wypytać go o morderstwo w dystrykcie.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B34/Descript.belarusian: Зайдзіце ў порт і папрасіце сустрэчу з лідарам мясцовага Саюза грузчыкаў, Эўрарам Клэрам. Вы павінны распытаць яго пра забойства ў раёне.

Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/Descript.english: The hanged man is down. Perform a closer inspection of his body, arriving at cause of death. This will need a form to be filled, in three parts.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/Descript.polish: Wisielec jest już na ziemi. Dokonaj szczegółowych oględzin ciała i określ przyczynę śmierci. Niezbędne będzie wypełnienie trzyczęściowego formularza.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/Descript.belarusian: Павешаны ўжо на зямлі. Правядзі пільнейшы агляд цела і вызнач прычыну смерці. Для гэтага спатрэбіцца запоўніць трохчасткавы бланк.

Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/subtask_.english: Bring chaincutters from Kim's toolbox in the Kineema.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/subtask_.polish: Przynieś nożyce do metalu ze skrzynki Kima w kineemie.
Conversation/0x0100000400011B3E/subtask_.belarusian: Прынясі балтарэз са скрыні для інструментаў Кіма ў Кініме.

Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Descript.english: Garte has told you some unruly Union men gather in the mess hall of the Whirling-in-Rags. They're not there today, but most likely they'll eventually show up -- keep an eye out for them.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Descript.polish: Garte powiedział ci, że grupa niesfornych członków Związku spotyka się w sali głównej Whirling-in-Rags. Dzisiaj ich tu nie ma, ale prawdopodobnie w końcu się pojawią. Wyczekuj ich.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Descript.belarusian: Гарт сказаў табе, што ў сталовай Whirling-in-Rags збіраюцца нейкія непакорлівыя прафсаюзнікі. Сёння іх няма, але хутчэй за ўсё яны ўрэшце з'явяцца — выглядай іх.

Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Title.english: Find out who is in the Union box
Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Title.polish: Dowiedz się, kto jest w sali zarezerwowanej przez Związek
Conversation/0x0100000400011BEB/Title.belarusian: Даведайся, хто сядзіць у кабінцы Прафсаюза

Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/Descript.english: Go upstairs and knock on the door #3 to talk to the supposed victim of the hanged man. See what she has to say to you.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/Descript.polish: Idź na piętro i zapukaj do drzwi nr 3, aby porozmawiać z rzekomą ofiarą powieszonego mężczyzny. Zobacz, co ma ci do powiedzenia.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/Descript.belarusian: Падніміся наверх і пастукай у дзверы № 3, каб пагаварыць з меркаванай ахвярай павешанага. Паслухай, што яна табе скажа.

Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.english: Find Klaasje so you can question to her.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.polish: Znajdź Klaasje, żeby móc ją przesłuchać.

Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.english: Get Klaasje's version of events, tactfully.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.polish: Taktownie poproś Klaasje o przedstawienie jej wersji wydarzeń.

Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.english: Confront the Hardie boys with what Klaasje told you.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z chłopakami Hardiego o tym, co powiedziała ci Klaasje.
Conversation/0x0100000400011BF3/subtask_.belarusian: Прыцісні Хлопцаў Хардзі тым, што табе сказала Клаас'е.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/Descript.english: Titus said Ruby -- the instigator of the lynching -- has a shack she rents on the coast. First go across the waterlock (south of Martinaise), then walk down the coast until you find a little fishing village. Ask around, the locals must have seen her.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/Descript.polish: Titus powiedział, że Ruby, która była prowodyrką linczu, wynajmuje na wybrzeżu chatę. Aby tam dotrzeć, musisz najpierw przejść przez śluzę (na południe od Martinaise), a potem iść brzegiem, póki nie dotrzesz do małej rybackiej wioski. Rozpytaj tam o nią, miejscowi na pewno ją widzieli.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/Descript.belarusian: Цітус сказаў, што Рубі — падбухторшчыца самасуду — арандуе халупу на ўзбярэжжы. Спачатку перайдзі праз шлюз (на поўдзень ад Марцінэза), потым ідзі ўздоўж узбярэжжа, пакуль не знойдзеш маленькую рыбацкую вёску. Распытай навокал, тутэйшыя мусілі яе бачыць.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/Title.english: Ask about Ruby in the village

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.english: Ask the fisherfolk in the village -- maybe their leader knows something?
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z rybakami we wsi. Może ich przywódca coś wie?
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з рыбакамі ў вёсцы — можа, іхні лідар нешта ведае?

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.english: The washerwoman is hiding something. Look around, maybe get into her shack somehow?
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.polish: Praczka coś ukrywa. Rozejrzyj się. Może zdołasz się jakoś dostać do jej chaty?
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.belarusian: Прачка нешта хавае. Азірніся, можа, неяк атрымаецца патрапіць у яе халупу?

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.english: You found a bullet in the washerwoman's shack. Ask her about it.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.polish: W chacie praczki znalazłeś nabój. Spytaj ją o niego.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.belarusian: Ты знайшоў кулю ў халупе прачкі. Распытай яе пра гэта.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.english: Ruby left the village and went up the coast. Explore the coast for signs.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.polish: Ruby opuściła wieś i ruszyła w drogę wzdłuż wybrzeża. Zbadaj je i poszukaj śladów.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.belarusian: Рубі сышла з вёскі і накіравалася ўздоўж узбярэжжа. Агледзь узбярэжжа ў пошуках слядоў.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.english: Looking for Ruby brought you to a mural that you somehow think is important. Inspect it thorougly.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.polish: Podczas poszukiwań Ruby natrafiłeś na mural, który wydaje ci się z jakiegoś powodu ważny. Przyjrzyj mu się dokładnie.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C02/subtask_.belarusian: Пошукі Рубі прывялі цябе да мурала, які чамусьці падаецца табе важным. Дасканала агледзь яго.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C10/Descript.english: Return to the Whirling after the whole Instigator debacle. Someone there has something to answer to.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C10/Descript.polish: Wróć do Whirling po całym tym zamieszaniu z podżegaczką. Ktoś tam musi za coś odpowiedzieć.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C10/Descript.belarusian: Вярніся ў Whirling пасля ўсяго гэтага фіяска з Падбухторшчыцай. Нехта там мусіць адказаць за свае ўчынкі.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/Descript.english: Go to the islet in the bay. There could be a boat in the fishing village, on the coast. Ask there.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/Descript.polish: Udaj się na wysepkę w zatoce. W rybackiej wsi na wybrzeżu może być łódź. Spytaj tam.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/Descript.belarusian: Выпраўляйся на астравок у заліве. У рыбацкай вёсцы на ўзбярэжжы можа быць човен. Распытай там.

Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/subtask_.english: Use the Net Picker's skiff on the jetty and go to the island.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/subtask_.polish: Użyj stojącej przy pomoście łodzi wybieraczki sieci i udaj się na wyspę.
Conversation/0x0100000400011C1E/subtask_.belarusian: Скарыстайся ялікам прыбіральніцы сяцей каля мола і выпраўляйся на востраў.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/Descript.english: You discovered a serial number on the victim's ceramic armour boots. Run the number using lieutenant Kitsuragi's shortwave in his motor carriage.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/Descript.polish: Na butach ceramicznego pancerza ofiary znalazłeś numer seryjny. Sprawdź go w kartotece, używając krótkofalówki porucznika Kitsuragiego w jego powozie motorowym.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/Descript.belarusian: Ты знайшоў серыйны нумар на ботах керамічнай брані ахвяры. Правер нумар па базе праз караткахвалевую рацыю лейтэнанта Кіцурагі ў ягонай маторнай карэце.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/Title.english: Run the number on the victim's armour
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/Title.polish: Sprawdź w kartotece numer znaleziony na pancerzu ofiary

Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.english: Use Kim's shortwave to run the serial number.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.polish: Użyj krótkofalówki Kima, aby sprawdzić numer seryjny.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.belarusian: Скарыстайся караткахвалевай рацыяй Кіма, каб праверыць серыйны нумар.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.english: Call Alice back in a day for info on the armour's owner.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.polish: Odezwij się do Alice po upływie jednego dnia, aby dowiedzieć się więcej o właścicielu pancerza.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.belarusian: Ператэлефануй Эліс праз дзень, каб атрымаць звесткі пра ўладальніка брані.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.english: Call Alice back in a day for info on the armour.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.polish: Odezwij się do Alice po upływie jednego dnia, aby dowiedzieć się więcej o pancerzu.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DA2/subtask_.belarusian: Ператэлефануй Эліс праз дзень, каб атрымаць звесткі пра браню.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DC3/Descript.english: The belly of this boat shines like it was recently painted.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DC3/Descript.polish: Brzuch tej łodzi błyszczy, jakby został niedawno pomalowany.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DC3/Descript.belarusian: Бруха гэтага чоўна блішчыць, нібы яго нядаўна пафарбавалі.

Conversation/0x0100000400011DD1/Descript.belarusian: ру дэ Сэн-Гілен -> Паўночная кальцавая развязка

Conversation/0x0100000400011DD8/Descript.english: Docking reserved for residents of: Rue de Saint-Ghislaine 33A
Conversation/0x0100000400011DD8/Descript.polish: Cumowanie tylko dla mieszkańców Rue de Saint-Ghislaine 33A
Conversation/0x0100000400011DD8/Descript.belarusian: Швартаванне толькі для жыхароў: ру дэ Сэн-Гілен, 33A

Conversation/0x0100000400011DDF/Descript.english: Looks like there was more construction here -- once, decades ago.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DDF/Descript.polish: Zdaje się, że kiedyś, dziesiątki lat temu, budowano tu coś więcej.
Conversation/0x0100000400011DDF/Descript.belarusian: Здаецца, калісьці, дзесяцігоддзі таму, тут будавалі нешта большае.

Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/Descript.english: Officers of the RCM carry a ledger with paperwork -- find yours so you'd be able to take official notes. Look around the yard. Something makes you think it's there.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/Descript.polish: Funkcjonariusze MOR-u mają własne notatniki z dokumentami – znajdź swój, żebyś mógł sporządzać oficjalne notatki. Rozejrzyj się po podwórzu. Coś ci mówi, że gdzieś tutaj jest.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/Descript.belarusian: Супрацоўнікі РГМ маюць уласныя нататнікі з дакументамі – знайдзі свой, каб мог весці афіцыйныя нататкі. Азірніся вакол двара. Нешта кажа табе, што дзесьці тут ён ёсць.

Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/subtask_.english: Check the Whirling trash container -- Sylvie said she threw out documents.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/subtask_.polish: Zajrzyj do pojemnika na śmieci przy Whirling – Sylivie mówiła, że wyrzucała dokumenty.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F4A/subtask_.belarusian: Правер смеццевы кантэйнер каля Whirling — Сільві казала, што выкінула дакументы.

Conversation/0x0100000400011F75/Descript.english: Shadows on the water... green plants under the calm surface.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F75/Descript.polish: Cienie na wodzie... Zielone rośliny pod spokojną taflą.
Conversation/0x0100000400011F75/Descript.belarusian: Цені на вадзе... зялёныя расліны пад спакойнай роўняддзю.

Conversation/0x0100000400014E02/Descript.english: Perhaps another mercenary can tell you more about the hanged man's tattoos, the so called 'Scab Leader' at the harbour gates. It won't count as one of the people informing you about the tattoos, but could be... interesting?
Conversation/0x0100000400014E02/Descript.polish: O tatuażach wisielca być może powie ci coś więcej inny najemnik, kręcący się u bram portu przywódca łamistrajków. Nie należy do osób, z którymi koniecznie musisz porozmawiać, ale może dowiesz się czegoś... interesującego?
Conversation/0x0100000400014E02/Descript.belarusian: Магчыма, іншы найміт распавядзе табе больш пра татуіроўкі павешанага — так званы "Лідар стачкаломаў" каля брамы порта. Ён не будзе лічыцца адным з тых, хто расказаў табе пра татуіроўкі, але гэта можа быць... цікава?

Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/Descript.english: The Horrific Necktie is getting ready for the end game. For the love of god do not remove it till 'the magic' happens.
Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/Descript.polish: Okropny krawat szykuje się na ostateczne starcie. Tylko na miłość boską, nie zdejmuj go, póki nie stanie się magia!
Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/Descript.belarusian: Жахлівы Гальштук рыхтуецца да фінальнай гульні. Дзеля ўсяго святога, не здымай яго, пакуль не адбудзецца 'магія'.

Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/subtask_.english: Hold onto the spirits and wait for the signal.
Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/subtask_.polish: Zachowaj alkohol i czekaj na sygnał.
Conversation/0x0100000400014E15/subtask_.belarusian: Трымай спірт пры сабе і чакай сігналу.

Conversation/0x0100000400014FA3/Descript.english: An old medicine cabinet, newly stocked with drouamine.
Conversation/0x0100000400014FA3/Descript.polish: Stara szafka na leki świeżo zaopatrzona w druaminę.
Conversation/0x0100000400014FA3/Descript.belarusian: Старая шафка для лекаў, свежа папоўненая друамінам.

Conversation/0x0100000400015197/Descript.english: A bust of a woman. The plaque simply says DEI.
Conversation/0x0100000400015197/Descript.polish: Popiersie kobiety. Na tabliczce napisano po prostu DEI.
Conversation/0x0100000400015197/Descript.belarusian: Бюст жанчыны. На таблічцы проста напісана: DEI.

Conversation/0x010000040001519E/Descript.english: Yellow roses. Dozens of them. Tulips too.
Conversation/0x010000040001519E/Descript.polish: Żółte róże. Całe dziesiątki. Są tu też tulipany.
Conversation/0x010000040001519E/Descript.belarusian: Жоўтыя ружы. Цэлыя дзясяткі. І цюльпаны таксама.

Conversation/0x01000004000151A4/Descript.english: The yellow roses in the window -- those aren't the flowers that were left for Klaasje.
Conversation/0x01000004000151A4/Descript.polish: Żółte róże w oknie. To nie są te kwiaty, które zostawiono dla Klaasje.
Conversation/0x01000004000151A4/Descript.belarusian: Жоўтыя ружы ў акне. Гэта не тыя кветкі, якія пакінулі для Клаас'е.

Conversation/0x01000004000151AA/Descript.polish: Na tabliczce widnieje napis „Tylko dla personelu”.

Conversation/0x01000004000151B6/Descript.english: The dishes are drying. They smell of chemicals and pine trees.
Conversation/0x01000004000151B6/Descript.polish: Naczynia obciekają z wody. Czuć je chemią i drzewem sosnowym.
Conversation/0x01000004000151B6/Descript.belarusian: Посуд сохне. Ад яго пахне хіміяй і хвояй.

Conversation/0x01000004000151BD/Descript.english: The tomatoes are so thinly sliced, you can see through them.
Conversation/0x01000004000151BD/Descript.polish: Pomidory są pokrojone tak cienko, że aż prześwitują.
Conversation/0x01000004000151BD/Descript.belarusian: Памідоры нарэзаныя так тонка, што аж прасвечваюць.

Conversation/0x01000004000151C4/Descript.english: A taxidermy fish that tells time.

Conversation/0x01000004000151CB/Descript.english: A blister pack of medicine peeks out of the box. You should take it!
Conversation/0x01000004000151CB/Descript.polish: Z pudełka wystaje blister leków. Powinieneś go wziąć!
Conversation/0x01000004000151CB/Descript.belarusian: Са скрынкі выглядае блістар з лекамі. Табе варта яго ўзяць!

Conversation/0x01000004000151FA/Descript.english: Someone has torn down the wall.

Conversation/0x0100000400015201/Descript.english: The wall collapsed. It's inaccessible now.
Conversation/0x0100000400015201/Descript.polish: Ściana się zawaliła. Nie ma już przejścia.
Conversation/0x0100000400015201/Descript.belarusian: Сцяна абвалілася. Туды больш не прайсці.

Conversation/0x0100000400015208/Descript.english: Spoken when entering the hidden weapon cache with Kim
Conversation/0x0100000400015208/Descript.polish: Wymawiane, kiedy wchodzisz z Kimem do skrytki z bronią
Conversation/0x0100000400015208/Descript.belarusian: Прамаўляецца, калі заходзіш у схованку са зброяй разам з Кімам.

Conversation/0x010000040001521C/Descript.english: The poster says: '*Citius* *Fortis*...' The rest is worn off.
Conversation/0x010000040001521C/Descript.polish: Na plakacie napisano: „*Citius* *Fortis*...” – reszta jest nieczytelna.

Conversation/0x0100000400015225/Descript.english: The central support beam has been destroyed by artillery fire.
Conversation/0x0100000400015225/Descript.polish: Centralny wspornik został zniszczony przez ogień artyleryjski.
Conversation/0x0100000400015225/Descript.belarusian: Цэнтральная апорная бэлька была знішчана артылерыйскім агнём.

Conversation/0x010000040001522B/Descript.english: Stones fall. It's a long way down...

Conversation/0x0100000400015235/Descript.polish: Staromodne meble biurowe. Jakoś sprzed wieku?
Conversation/0x0100000400015235/Descript.belarusian: Старамодная офісная мэбля. Можа, з мінулага стагоддзя?

Conversation/0x010000040001523B/Descript.english: Brought down and forgotten, so long ago...
Conversation/0x010000040001523B/Descript.polish: Zniszczone i zapomniane, tak dawno temu...

Conversation/0x0100000400015241/Descript.english: This collapse nearly sealed the basement. One can barely squeeze by.
Conversation/0x0100000400015241/Descript.polish: Zawalone mury zablokowały nieomal wejście do piwnicy. Ledwo można się tam wcisnąć.
Conversation/0x0100000400015241/Descript.belarusian: Гэты завал амаль замураваў склеп. Скрозь яго ледзь можна праціснуцца.

Conversation/0x0100000400015247/Descript.english: This overturned table is covered in orange mildew. Crawling with something...
Conversation/0x0100000400015247/Descript.polish: Przewrócony stół pokryty jest pomarańczową pleśnią. Coś po nim pełza...
Conversation/0x0100000400015247/Descript.belarusian: Гэты перакулены стол пакрыты памаранчавай цвіллю. Па ім нешта поўзае...

Conversation/0x0100000400015251/Descript.english: Dark water trails into the distance. There is no way out.
Conversation/0x0100000400015251/Descript.polish: Ciemna woda ginie w oddali. Nie da się wyjść.
Conversation/0x0100000400015251/Descript.belarusian: Цёмная вада цячэ ўдалячынь. Выйсця няма.

Conversation/0x0100000400015257/Descript.english: A concrete pipe, buried in sand and dust.
Conversation/0x0100000400015257/Descript.polish: Betonowa rura zasypana piaskiem i pyłem.
Conversation/0x0100000400015257/Descript.belarusian: Бетонная труба, засыпаная пяском і пылам.

Conversation/0x0100000400015263/Descript.english: It's getting louder, the buzzing sound...

Conversation/0x0100000400015274/Descript.english: In the beam of the flashlight -- a crevice in the wall...
Conversation/0x0100000400015274/Descript.polish: W snopie światła z latarki pojawia się ona – szczelina w ścianie...
Conversation/0x0100000400015274/Descript.belarusian: У промні ліхтарыка — шчыліна ў сцяне...

Conversation/0x010000040001527B/Descript.english: A series of thick, dusty panes of glass.

Conversation/0x01000004000152E3/Descript.english: You see a dark red chair in the dim light of the room.
Conversation/0x01000004000152E3/Descript.polish: W półmroku pomieszczenia widzisz ciemnoczerwone krzesło.
Conversation/0x01000004000152E3/Descript.belarusian: У прыцемках пакоя бачна цёмна-чырвонае крэсла.

Conversation/0x01000004000152F5/Descript.english: A cold breeze is enough to make the wall planks creak.
Conversation/0x01000004000152F5/Descript.polish: Chłodny powiew wystarczy, żeby deski ściany zaczęły skrzypieć.
Conversation/0x01000004000152F5/Descript.belarusian: Халоднага ветрыку дастаткова, каб дошкі ў сцяне зарыпелі.

Conversation/0x010000040001542B/Descript.english: There are bottles inside. You could pick them up if you had a bag!
Conversation/0x010000040001542B/Descript.polish: W środku są butelki. Gdybyś miał torbę, mógłbyś je wziąć!
Conversation/0x010000040001542B/Descript.belarusian: Унутры ёсць бутэлькі. Калі б у цябе была торба, ты мог бы іх забраць!

Conversation/0x0100000400015431/Descript.english: If you had a bag in your hand, perhaps you could collect these bottles and sell them.
Conversation/0x0100000400015431/Descript.polish: Gdybyś miał w ręce torbę, może mógłbyś wziąć te butelki i je sprzedać.
Conversation/0x0100000400015431/Descript.belarusian: Калі б у цябе ў руцэ была торба, ты, мажліва, мог бы сабраць гэтыя бутэлькі і здаць іх.

Conversation/0x0100000400015447/Descript.english: Just a door. Nothing for you here right now.
Conversation/0x0100000400015447/Descript.polish: Zwykłe drzwi. Chwilowo nie masz tu czego szukać.
Conversation/0x0100000400015447/Descript.belarusian: Звычайныя дзверы. Зараз табе тут няма чаго шукаць.

Conversation/0x0100000400015450/Descript.english: White pine trees are printed onto the screen covering. Looks like a forest under snow.
Conversation/0x0100000400015450/Descript.polish: Na osłonie ekranu nadrukowane są białe drzewa sosnowe. Wyglądają niczym zaśnieżony las.
Conversation/0x0100000400015450/Descript.belarusian: На палатне шырмы надрукаваныя белыя сосны. Выглядае як заснежаны лес.

Conversation/0x0100000400015457/Descript.english: The banner sags under the weight of rain and snow: white waves on red.
Conversation/0x0100000400015457/Descript.polish: Transparent ugina się pod ciężarem deszczu i śniegu; białe fale na tle czerwieni.
Conversation/0x0100000400015457/Descript.belarusian: Банер правісае пад цяжарам дажджу і снегу: белыя хвалі на чырвоным.

Conversation/0x0100000400015460/Descript.english: A breaker box to power the radio pylon above you. Maybe there's something inside?
Conversation/0x0100000400015460/Descript.polish: Bezpieczniki wznoszącego się nad tobą pylonu radiowego. Może coś jest w środku?
Conversation/0x0100000400015460/Descript.belarusian: Скрыня з засцерагальнікамі, якая сілкуе радыёмачту над табой. Можа, унутры нешта ёсць?

Conversation/0x0100000400015466/Descript.english: It's not only shut -- it's filled with concrete. No getting in here.
Conversation/0x0100000400015466/Descript.polish: Są nie tylko zamknięte, ale też zalane betonem. Nie ma mowy o wejściu do środka.
Conversation/0x0100000400015466/Descript.belarusian: Яны не проста зачыненыя — яны залітыя бетонам. Сюды ніяк не патрапіць.

Conversation/0x010000040001546C/Descript.english: The sign says: "No Entry." Someone's scribbled an inverted star on it.
Conversation/0x010000040001546C/Descript.polish: Na znaku widnieje napis „Zakaz wstępu”. Ktoś nabazgrał na nim odwróconą gwiazdę.
Conversation/0x010000040001546C/Descript.belarusian: На знаку напісана: "Уваход забаронены". Хтосьці надрапаў на ім перавернутую зорку.

Conversation/0x0100000400015472/Descript.english: Paint peels from the swing set in coin-sized flakes.
Conversation/0x0100000400015472/Descript.polish: Farba złazi z huśtawek płatami wielkości monety.
Conversation/0x0100000400015472/Descript.belarusian: Фарба з арэляў аблупліваецца кавалкамі памерам з манету.

Conversation/0x0100000400015478/Descript.english: Ahead: decades old concrete defences. Children play on them now.
Conversation/0x0100000400015478/Descript.polish: Przed tobą betonowe umocnienia sprzed dziesiątek lat. Dziś bawią się na nich dzieci.
Conversation/0x0100000400015478/Descript.belarusian: Наперадзе — бетонныя ўмацаванні, узведзеныя дзесяцігоддзі таму. Цяпер на іх гуляюць дзеці.
