Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.english: Vol. 1 No. 2 of *La Fumée*, Martinaise's leading quarterly journal of radical Mazovian thought (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.polish: Wyd. 1, nr 2 *La Fumée*, wiodącego martyneskiego kwartalnika wyznawców radykalnej myśli mazowskiej (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.belarusian: Том 1, № 2 *La Fumée*, галоўнага штоквартальнага часопіса радыкальнай мазавісцкай думкі Марцінэза (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ "КАМУНІСТЫЧНЫ СОН").

Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.english: An Introduction to the Theories of Ignus Nilsen (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.polish: Wprowadzenie do teroii Ignusa Nilsena (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.belarusian: Уводзіны ў тэорыі Ігнуса Нільсэна (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ "КАМУНІСТЫЧНЫ СОН").

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.english: Empathy tells you it's time to take responsibility... by convening a committee to spread responsibility around.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.polish: Empatia podpowiada ci, że czas wziąć na siebie odpowiedzialność... utworzenia komitetu, który pozwoli rozmyć odpowiedzialność.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.belarusian: Эмпатыя кажа табе, што час узяць на сябе адказнасць... склікаўшы камітэт, каб размеркаваць яе між іншымі.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.english: Things down here are a *mess*. Someone really ought to do something about it. First, though, you and some other moralists should probably form a committee to decide whose job it is.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.polish: Bajzel tu jest *niesamowity*. Ktoś naprawdę powinien coś z tym zrobić. Najpierw jednak powinieneś chyba wraz z innymi moralistami stworzyć komitet, który zdecyduje, czyje to będzie zadanie.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.belarusian: Справы тут — сапраўдны *гармідар*. Нехта пэўна мусіць нешта з гэтым зрабіць. Але спачатку табе з іншымі маралістамі, напэўна, варта стварыць камітэт, каб вырашыць, чый гэта абавязак.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Form a committee of moralists to assign responsibility. Kim might know where to start?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Stwórz komitet moralistów, który będzie przydzielał obowiązki. Może Kim będzie wiedział, od czego zacząć?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Ствары камітэт маралістаў, каб размеркаваць адказнасць. Можа, Кім ведае, з чаго пачаць?

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should keep your eyes peeled for moralists (may take a while).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś rozglądać się za moralistami (może to nieco zająć).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа пільна глядзець па баках у пошуках маралістаў (гэта можа заняць пэўны час).

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should look for the Sunday Friend. The Smoker on the Balcony might know where he is.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś poszukać Niedzielnego Przyjaciela. Balkonowy palacz może wiedzieć, gdzie go szukać.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа, што трэба пашукаць Нядзельнага сябра. Курэц на гаўбцы можа ведаць, дзе ён.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should talk with Trant Heidelstam.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś porozmawiać z Trantem Heidelstamem.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа, што табе трэба пагаварыць з Трантам Хайдэльстамам.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: The Smoker says his Sunday Friend has gone for a stroll along the coast.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Palacz twierdzi, że jego Niedzielny Przyjaciel udał się na spacer wzdłuż wybrzeża.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Курэц кажа, што яго Нядзельны сябра пайшоў шпацыраваць уздоўж узбярэжжа.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Find someone with technical expertise to contact the Coalition.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź kogoś, kto będzie miał wiedzę techniczną niezbędną, by nawiązać kontakt z Koalicją.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі кагосьці з тэхнічнымі ведамі, каб звязацца з Кааліцыяй.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Inspect the antenna at Land's End.
Come up with a suitable location for a giant antenna.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź odpowiednie miejsce dla wielkiej anteny.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Прыдумай адпаведнае месца для гіганцкай антэны.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Find a working transceiver and return to the church.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź działający transiwer i wróć do kościoła.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі спраўны трансівер і вярніся ў царкву.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Skontaktuj się z Okrętem Wojennym Koalicji „Łucznik”.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BF28/Descript.english: CUTSCENE where you attempt to contact Coalition Warship Archer with NOID. PART OF THE MORALIST DREAM QUEST
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BF28/Descript.polish: PRZERYWNIK, podczas którego wraz z NOIKIEM próbujesz skontaktować się z Okrętem Wojennym Koalicji „Łucznik”. CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA SEN MORALISTY
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BF28/Descript.belarusian: КАТСЦЭНА, дзе ты разам з Ноікам спрабуеш звязацца з вайсковым караблём Кааліцыі "Лучнік". ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ "СОН МАРАЛІСТА"

Conversation/0x0100000F0000E7AE/Descript.english: You can remove the transceiver from this radio as part of the MORALIST DREAM QUEST
Conversation/0x0100000F0000E7AE/Descript.polish: Możesz zabrać z tego radia transiwer w ramach ZADANIA SEN MORALISTY
Conversation/0x0100000F0000E7AE/Descript.belarusian: Ты можаш выняць трансівер з гэтага радыё ў межах ЗАДАННЯ "СОН МАРАЛІСТА"

Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA1F/Descript.english: There's no way you'll reach the Coalition with this piece of junk...
Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA1F/Descript.polish: Nie ma mowy, żebyś nawiązał kontakt z Koalicją za pomocą tej kupy złomu...
Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA1F/Descript.belarusian: Ты нізашто не даклічашся да Кааліцыі праз гэтае ламачча...

Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA29/Descript.english: PART OF THE MORALIST DREAM QUEST. You come across the Sunday friend enjoying the historical scenery. You also have the chance to apologise if you accused him earlier.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA29/Descript.polish: CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA SEN MORALISTY. Natknąłeś się na Niedzielnego Przyjaciela podziwiającego historyczną scenerię. Masz też szansę przeprosić, jeśli go wcześniej oskarżyłeś.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000EA29/Descript.belarusian: ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ "СОН МАРАЛІСТА". Ты натыкаешся на Нядзельнага сябра, які любуецца гістарычным краявідам. У цябе таксама ёсць магчымасць папрасіць прабачэння, калі ты абвінаваціў яго раней.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011584/Descript.english: Savoir Faire tells you it's time to stop playing the market and make some real cash so you can fulfil your heart's desire.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011584/Descript.polish: Savoir faire podpowiada ci, że najwyższy czas przestać spekulować i zacząć zarabiać prawdziwe pieniądze, jeśli chcesz zrealizować swoje pragnienia.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011584/Descript.belarusian: Savoir Faire падказвае вам, што пара перастаць спекуляваць і пачаць зарабляць рэальныя грошы, калі вы хочаце ажыццявіць свае жаданні.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/Descript.english: No more messing around. It's time to get rich for real! Just play the market right and you'll be a millionaire by the end of the week. Then you can get what your heart desires. Whatever it is...
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/Descript.polish: Dość wygłupów. Czas się naprawdę wzbogacić! Zagraj dobrze na giełdzie, a nim upłynie tydzień, będziesz milionerem. A wtedy będziesz mógł zrealizować swoje pragnienia. Czymkolwiek one są...
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/Descript.belarusian: Хопіць дуронікаў строіць. Час узбагаціцца па-сапраўднаму! Проста згуляй правільна на біржы — і да канца тыдня будзеш мільянерам. А тады атрымаеш усё, чаго душа пажадае. Што б гэта ні было...

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Find a starving artist and become their patron.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.polish: Znajdź głodującego artystę i zostań jego mecenasem.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі галоднага мастака і стань яго мецэнатам.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Find a buyer for Cindy's art -- someone inconceivably *rich*.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.polish: Znajdź kogoś, kto kupi dzieła Cindy. Kogoś niewyobrażalnie *bogatego*.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі пакупніка для мастацтва Сіндзі — кагосьці неймаверна *багатага*.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Get yourself a Personal Brand Strategist.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.polish: Znajdź sobie eksperta od rozwoju marki.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі сабе эксперта па развіцці брэнда.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Discuss the re-conceptualization with Idiot Doom Spiral.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z Idiotą w Spirali Katastrof o rekonceptualizacji.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.belarusian: Абмяркуй рэканцэптуалізацыю з Лёсам Кручаным Ёлупам.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Check back on the monument re-conceptualization later.
Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.polish: Wróć potem do sprawy rekonceptualizacji pomnika.

Conversation/0x0100000F0001183F/Descript.english: Savoir Faire spots Cindy and gives you a pep talk before you try to negotiate for her art.
Conversation/0x0100000F0001183F/Descript.polish: Savoir faire widzi Cindy i urządza ci gadkę motywującą przed próbą negocjacji w sprawie jej dzieł.
Conversation/0x0100000F0001183F/Descript.belarusian: Savoir Faire бачыць Сінді і ўладкоўвае табе матывацыйную размову перад спробай перамоў аб яе творах.

Conversation/0x0100000F0001200E/Descript.english: Savoir Faire hears wealth humming in the container -- whether it's raised or lowered. Also gives you instant access to MRLBG.
Conversation/0x0100000F0001200E/Descript.polish: Savoir faire słyszy w pojemniku – niezależnie od tego, czy się on wznosi, czy opada – odgłos bogactwa. Daje ci też natychmiastowy dostęp do SBZŚG.
Conversation/0x0100000F0001200E/Descript.belarusian: Savoir Faire чуе ў ёмістасці – незалежна ад таго, ці яна падымаецца, ці апускаецца – гук багацця. Гэта таксама дае табе імгненны доступ да СБЗГС.

Conversation/0x0100000F0001476A/Descript.english: Read the Stock Certificate traded with MRLBG
Conversation/0x0100000F0001476A/Descript.polish: Przeczytaj certyfikat zakupu akcji od SBZŚG
Conversation/0x0100000F0001476A/Descript.belarusian: Прачытай сертыфікат валодання акцыямі, выменяны ў MRLBG

Conversation/0x0100000F000149FB/Descript.english: After the Tribunal, Harry reflects on the re-conceptualization of the horseback monument by Idiot Doom Spiral. (ULTRALIBERAL DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F000149FB/Descript.polish: Po posiedzeniu trybunału Harry rozmyśla o rekonceptualizacji pomnika jeźdźca przez Idiotę w Spirali Katastrof (ZADANIE SEN ULTRALIBERAŁA).
Conversation/0x0100000F000149FB/Descript.belarusian: Пасля Трыбунала Гары разважае пра рэканцэптуалізацыю статуі вершніка Лёсам Кручаным Ёлупам. (ЗАДАННЕ "СОН УЛЬТРАЛІБЕРАЛА")

Conversation/0x0100001600002F1B/Descript.english: Some great tectonic force has cracked the pavement, like an eggshell.
Conversation/0x0100001600002F1B/Descript.polish: Jakaś potężna siła tektoniczna rozbiła asfalt niczym skorupkę jajka.
Conversation/0x0100001600002F1B/Descript.belarusian: Нейкая магутная тэктанічная сіла раскалола брук, нібы яечную шкарлупіну.

Conversation/0x01000016000089F7/Descript.english: Garte + Sylvie = ?? Something's going on here. You need to help a brother out with his love-woes. Go to Garte and give him some solid advice. Tell him how it *is* with women.
Conversation/0x01000016000089F7/Descript.polish: Garte + Sylvie = ??. Coś się tu dzieje. Musisz wspomóc brata w jego miłosnych problemach. Idź do Garte'a i udziel mu dobrej rady. Powiedz mu, jak to *jest* z kobietami.
Conversation/0x01000016000089F7/Descript.belarusian: Гарт + Сільві = ??. Нешта тут адбываецца. Ты павінен дапамагчы брату ў ягоных любоўных праблемах. Ідзі да Гарта і дай яму добрую параду. Скажы яму, як гэта *ёсць* з жанчынамі.

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/Descript.english: The hanged man's armour seems to be missing. Find out what happened to it. The kid throwing rocks at the corpse seems to be a good place to start. (Ask him about the body first.)
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/Descript.polish: Wygląda na to, że wisielec nie ma pancerza. Dowiedz się, co się z nim stało. Na początek warto spytać rzucającego w trupa kamieniami dzieciaka (najpierw spytaj go o samo ciało).
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/Descript.belarusian: Здаецца, у Павешанага зніклі даспехі. Даведайся, што з імі здарылася. Малы, які шпурляе камяні ў труп, — нядрэнны варыянт для пачатку. (Спачатку распытай яго пра само цела.)

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/Title.english: Where is the rest of the armour?

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.english: Ask Cuno (the kid throwing rocks) what he knows.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.polish: Spytaj Cuna (rzucającego kamieniami dzieciaka), co wie.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.belarusian: Спытай Куно (кідаючага камянямі дзіцяці), што ён ведае.

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.english: Go to the harbour gates, ask *the jolly Mesque* about the armour.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.polish: Udaj się do bramy portu i spytaj *wesołego Meska* o pancerz.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.belarusian: Ідзі да брамы порта, спытай *вясёлага мескійца* пра даспехі.

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.english: Cuno lied to you. Return and confront him.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.polish: Cuno cię okłamał. Wróć i spytaj go, dlaczego to zrobił.
Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/subtask_.belarusian: Куна схлусіў табе. Вярніся і выведзі яго на чыстую ваду.

Conversation/0x0100001600008B65/Descript.english: Is this the water lock Lena mentioned?
Conversation/0x0100001600008B65/Descript.polish: To jest ta śluza, o której wspominała Lena?
Conversation/0x0100001600008B65/Descript.belarusian: Гэта той шлюз, пра які казала Лена?

Conversation/0x0100001600008D12/Descript.english: Aha, the drug lab! Can't wait for the profits to start rolling in...
Conversation/0x0100001600008D12/Descript.polish: Aha! Fabryka narkotyków! Nie mogę się doczekać, aż zaczną wpadać zyski...
Conversation/0x0100001600008D12/Descript.belarusian: Ага, наркалабараторыя! Не дачакаюся, пакуль пацячэ прыбытак...

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/Descript.english: Check the traps for Morell the cryptozoologist, so he and his friend Gary can get some rest. There are four traps in total. After checking them all, return to Morell with the news.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/Descript.polish: Sprawdź pułapki dla kryptozoologa Morella, żeby razem ze swoim przyjacielem Garym mógł trochę odpocząć. Łącznie są cztery pułapki. Sprawdź je wszystkie i powiadom Morella.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/Descript.belarusian: Правер пасткі для крыптазаолага Марэля, каб ён са сваім сябрам Гэры мог трохі адпачыць. Усяго пастак чатыры. Праверыўшы ўсе, вярніся да Марэля з навінамі.

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.english: Check the trap near the boathouses, west of the Feld building.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.polish: Sprawdź pułapkę przy szopach na łodzie, na zachód od budynku Felda.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.belarusian: Праверце пастку каля лодачных адрын, на захад ад будынка Feld.

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.english: Check the trap Morell just set up, in the cryptozoologist camp.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.polish: Sprawdź pułapkę, którą Morell dopiero co przygotował, w obozie kryptozoologów.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.belarusian: Правер пастку, якую Марэль толькі што паставіў, у лагеры крыптазаолагаў.

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.english: Check the trap in Land's End, far north-east of the Feld building.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.polish: Sprawdź pułapkę na Krańcu, daleko na północny wschód od budynku Felda.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.belarusian: Праверце пастку на Краі Свету, далёка на паўночны ўсход ад будынка Feld.

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.english: Check the trap near the canal you crossed, south-east of the village.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.polish: Sprawdź pułapkę przy kanale, który przekroczyłeś, na południowy wschód od wsi.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.belarusian: Праверце пастку каля канала, які вы перайшлі, на паўднёвы ўсход ад вёскі.

Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.english: The last trap was empty! Return to Morell in the Whirling with the news.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.polish: Ostatnia pułapka była pusta! Wróć do Whirling, do Morella, z wieściami.
Conversation/0x01000016000090E3/subtask_.belarusian: Апошняя пастка была пустая! Вярніцеся ў Whirling да Марэля з навінамі.

Conversation/0x0100001600009AE2/Descript.english: Bars cover these long, dusty windows.
Conversation/0x0100001600009AE2/Descript.polish: Wysokie, zakurzone okna chronione są metalowymi prętami.
Conversation/0x0100001600009AE2/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя доўгія, запыленыя вокны закрытыя кратамі.

Conversation/0x0100001600009B24/Descript.english: The gusts of wind, the height feels dizzying.
Conversation/0x0100001600009B24/Descript.polish: Powiewy wiatru i wysokość przyprawiają cię o zawroty głowy.
Conversation/0x0100001600009B24/Descript.belarusian: Ад парываў ветру і вышыні кружыцца галава.

Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Descript.english: There's a dead body on the Martinaise boardwalk down the coast. Return to it with the lieutenant and decide what to do with it.
Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Descript.polish: Na biegnącej wzdłuż wybrzeża promenadzie Martinaise leży ciało. Wróć do niego z porucznikiem i zdecyduj, co z nim zrobić.
Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Descript.belarusian: На праменадзе Мартынайз, якая ідзе ўздоўж узбярэжжа, ляжыць цела. Вярніцеся да яго з лейтэнантам і вырашыце, што з ім рабіць.

Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Title.english: Return to the dead body with Kim

Conversation/0x01000021000020E9/Descript.english: Before you, a drawbridge. It can only be lowered from the other side.
Conversation/0x01000021000020E9/Descript.polish: Przed sobą masz most zwodzony. Można go opuścić tylko z drugiego brzegu.
Conversation/0x01000021000020E9/Descript.belarusian: Перад табой разводны мост. Яго можна апусціць толькі з таго боку.

Conversation/0x01000021000020FB/Descript.english: To your right, a white-bellied cormorant eyes you suspiciously.
Conversation/0x01000021000020FB/Descript.polish: Po prawej widzisz białobrzuchego kormorana, który przygląda ci się podejrzliwie.
Conversation/0x01000021000020FB/Descript.belarusian: Справа ад цябе белабрухі баклан з падазрэннем сочыць за табой.

Conversation/0x010000210000223E/Descript.english: Don't run, okay? Take it slow when exploring the apartment. Be respectful.
Conversation/0x010000210000223E/Descript.polish: Nie biegaj, dobrze? Krocz z godnością, badając mieszkanie. Okaż szacunek.
Conversation/0x010000210000223E/Descript.belarusian: Не бяжы, добра? Не спяшайся, калі аглядаеш кватэру. Праяві павагу.

Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.english: There are rumours that the previous forewoman of the Union just disappeared, right before the Claires took over. Her daughter called in on the election eve and said she wasn't running any more -- or coming to work. What happened?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.polish: Krążą pogłoski, że dawna przywódczyni Związku po prostu zniknęła tuż przed tym, jak władzę przejęli Claire'owie. Jej córka poinformowała w przeddzień wyborów, że nie będzie ona już startować na ten urząd. Ani przychodzić do pracy. Co się stało?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.belarusian: Ходзяць чуткі, што былая лідарка Саюза проста знікла неўзабаве да таго, як уладу захапілі Клэры. Яе дачка паведаміла ў пераддзень выбараў, што яна больш не будзе вылучацца на гэтую пасаду. І не будзе прыходзіць на працу. Што здарылася?

Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Title.english: What happened to the previous forewoman?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Title.polish: Co się stało z dawną przywódczynią?

Conversation/0x0100002700000E84/Descript.english: A sign reads: "Mess hall reserved for Union members. Doors open: 16:00."
Conversation/0x0100002700000E84/Descript.polish: Napis na znaku głosi: „Stołówka zarezerwowana dla członków Związku. Otwarcie o godzinie 16:00”.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E84/Descript.belarusian: На шыльдзе напісана: "Сталоўка зарэзерваваная для сяброў Прафсаюза. Дзверы адчыняюцца: 16:00".

Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.english: Inside you catch a glimpse of Union paraphernalia: a strike poster, some red pennants.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.polish: W środku dostrzegasz materiały związkowe: plakat strajkowy, czerwone proporczyki.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.belarusian: Унутры ты заўважаеш прафсаюзную атрыбутыку: страйкавы плакат, некалькі чырвоных вымпелаў.

Conversation/0x0100002700000E95/Descript.english: This is a water cooler. A large bubble is rising to the surface.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E95/Descript.polish: Dystrybutor na wodę. Ku powierzchni wznosi się duży bąbel powietrza.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E95/Descript.belarusian: Гэта кулер для вады. Да паверхні падымаецца вялікая бурбалка.

Conversation/0x0100002700000E9D/Descript.english: The menu has been wiped clean. Only the word MONDAY is written on it.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E9D/Descript.polish: Menu zostało starte. Pozostało tylko słowo PONIEDZIAŁEK.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E9D/Descript.belarusian: Меню сцёртае. Засталося толькі слова ПАНЯДЗЕЛАК.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EAC/Descript.english: The soft purr of an electric juicer comes from the kitchen. Someone is working.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EAC/Descript.polish: Z kuchni dobiega pomruk elektrycznej wyciskarki do soków. Ktoś tam pracuje.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EAC/Descript.belarusian: З кухні чуваць ціхае гудзенне электрычнай сокавыціскалкі. Хтосьці там працуе.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EBC/Descript.english: The door is bolted. A sign reads: "Kitchen reserved for personnel until 13.00."
Conversation/0x0100002700000EBC/Descript.polish: Drzwi są zaryglowane. Na znaku widnieje napis: „Do 13:00 kuchnia zarezerwowana dla personelu”.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EBC/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы засунутыя на завалу. На шыльдзе напісана: "Да 13:00 кухня толькі для персаналу".

Conversation/0x0100002700000ECD/Descript.english: A woman's hand wrote yesterday's menu. Today's starts in a man's handwriting.
Conversation/0x0100002700000ECD/Descript.polish: Menu na wczoraj napisała kobieca ręka. Dzisiejsze – już męska.
Conversation/0x0100002700000ECD/Descript.belarusian: Учорашняе меню напісана жаночай рукой. Сённяшняе пачынаецца мужчынскім почыркам.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EDC/Descript.english: The smell of the sea makes you dizzy.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EDC/Descript.polish: Zapach morza przyprawia cię o zawroty głowy.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EDC/Descript.belarusian: Ад паху мора ў цябе кружыцца галава.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EE4/Descript.english: A gust of briny wind washes over you.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EF7/Descript.english: This Royal Pinball machine is unplugged.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EF7/Descript.polish: Maszyna firmy Królewski Pinball jest odłączona.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EF7/Descript.belarusian: Гэты пінбольны аўтамат Royal Pinball адключаны ад сеткі.

Conversation/0x0100002700000F80/Descript.english: A bottle of rum has been knocked over. Beautiful, dark liquid is spilling out...
Conversation/0x0100002700000F80/Descript.polish: Ktoś przewrócił butelkę rumu. Wycieka z niej piękny, ciemny płyn...
Conversation/0x0100002700000F80/Descript.belarusian: Бутэлька рому перакуленая. З яе выліваецца прыгожая, цёмная вадкасць...

Conversation/0x0100002700000FB2/Descript.english: This is the weekend edition of the satirical newspaper "Trompe le Monde".
Conversation/0x0100002700000FB2/Descript.polish: Weekendowe wydanie satyrycznej gazety „Trompe le Monde”.
Conversation/0x0100002700000FB2/Descript.belarusian: Нядзельны выпуск сатырычнай газеты «Trompe le Monde».

Conversation/0x0100002700001028/Descript.english: The letter "R" wears a crown. On the ribbon below: "A Light Above Descending."
Conversation/0x0100002700001028/Descript.polish: Nad literą „R” widnieje korona. Pod nią widnieje wstęga z napisem „Światło zstępuje z góry”.
Conversation/0x0100002700001028/Descript.belarusian: Літара "R" увянчаная каронай. На стужцы знізу: "Святло, што сыходзіць зверху".

Conversation/0x010000270000104A/Descript.english: This kids' ladder is rickety but still climbable.
Conversation/0x010000270000104A/Descript.polish: Drabinka dla dzieciaków jest chwiejna, ale można po niej wejść.
Conversation/0x010000270000104A/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая дзіцячая драбінка хісткая, але па ёй усё яшчэ можна залезці.

Conversation/0x0100002700001059/Descript.english: The ladder's for kids -- it wouldn't hold the weight of a grown man.
Conversation/0x0100002700001059/Descript.polish: Drabinka jest dla dzieci. Nie utrzyma dorosłego mężczyzny.
Conversation/0x0100002700001059/Descript.belarusian: Драбінка для дзяцей — яна не вытрымае дарослага мужчыну.

Conversation/0x0100002700001066/Descript.english: Someone is trying to grow herbs in this greenhouse.
Conversation/0x0100002700001066/Descript.polish: Ktoś próbuje wyhodować w tej szklarni zioła.
Conversation/0x0100002700001066/Descript.belarusian: Нехта спрабуе вырошчваць зеляніну ў гэтай цяпліцы.

Conversation/0x010000270000106F/Descript.english: A sign on the door says the balcony is closed for spring.
Conversation/0x010000270000106F/Descript.polish: Tabliczka na drzwiach informuje, że taras jest zamknięty na wiosnę.
Conversation/0x010000270000106F/Descript.belarusian: Шыльда на дзвярах паведамляе, што балкон зачынены на вясну.

Conversation/0x0100002700001094/Descript.english: This magnum-sized bottle of "Commodore Red" is empty.
Conversation/0x0100002700001094/Descript.polish: Ta duża butelka Czerwonego Komandosa jest pusta.

Conversation/0x010000290000182D/Descript.english: You've volunteered to restock the empty trap for the cryptozoologists. They even gave you fresh box of locusts. This could, after some messing around, *probably* lead to the discovery?
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/Descript.polish: Zgłosiłeś się na ochotnika, by napełnić przynętą pustą pułapkę kryptozoologów. Dali ci nawet pudełko świeżej szarańczy. Mogłoby to, przy odrobinie starań, *chyba* doprowadzić do odkrycia?
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/Descript.belarusian: Ты падахвоціўся пакласці прынаду ў пустую пастку для крыптазаолагаў. Яны нават далі табе скрынку свежай саранчы. Гэта магло б, пасля пэўнай валтузні, *мабыць*, прывесці да адкрыцця?

Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.english: First restock the trap you left empty before (the trick is to remember which one it was).
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.polish: Najpierw uzupełnij przynętą pułapkę, którą poprzednio zostawiłeś pustą (trudność polega na tym, żeby pamiętać, która to była).
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.belarusian: Спачатку пакладзі прынаду ў пастку, якую ты пакінуў пустой (галоўнае — успомніць, якую менавіта).

Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.english: You've restocked the trap -- now report to Lena in the Whirling.
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.polish: Pułapka znów ma przynętę. Teraz zgłoś się do Leny w Whirling.
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.belarusian: Ты паклаў у пастку прынаду — цяпер паведамі Лене ў Whirling.

Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.english: Lena is hiding something -- ask her what it is.
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.polish: Lena coś ukrywa. Spytaj ją o to.
Conversation/0x010000290000182D/subtask_.belarusian: Лена нешта хавае — спытай у яе, што менавіта.

Conversation/0x0100002B00005235/Descript.english: This coin operated viewer has been banged up, inoperable.
Conversation/0x0100002B00005235/Descript.polish: Lornetka na monety jest cała poobijana i niezdatna do użytku.
Conversation/0x0100002B00005235/Descript.belarusian: Гэты манетны бінокль увесь пабіты і не працуе.

Conversation/0x0100002B00006C18/Descript.english: The hangover feels really bad. You have to take the edge off. Find a bottle of alcohol, put it in your hand (equip it in the HELD slot in your INVENTORY), and the magic will happen by its own!
Conversation/0x0100002B00006C18/Descript.polish: Masz naprawdę potężnego kaca. Może być potrzebny klin. Znajdź butelkę alkoholu, weź ją do ręki (umieść ją w miejscu „P ręka” lub „L ręka”) i czekaj, aż stanie się magia!
Conversation/0x0100002B00006C18/Descript.belarusian: У цябе сапраўды жудаснае пахмелле. Трэба паправіць здароўе. Знайдзі бутэльку спіртнога, вазьмі яе ў руку (экіпіруй у слот У РУЦЭ ў РЫШТУНКУ), і магія адбудзецца сама сабой!

Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/Descript.english: Somehow make it so that the bloated corpse isn't up there any more. Shoot it down or ask for help. Do something, you're a cop.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/Descript.polish: Spraw jakoś, żeby ten rozdęty trup przestał być tam na górze. Zestrzel go albo poproś o pomoc. Zrób coś. Jesteś policjantem.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/Descript.belarusian: Зрабі неяк так, каб гэты раздзьмуты труп больш не вісеў там наверсе. Збі яго стрэлам ці папрасі дапамогі. Зрабі што-небудзь, ты ж паліцыянт.

Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.english: Access the harbour and ask for Evrart Claire's help.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.polish: Dostań się do portu i poproś o pomoc Evrarta Claire'a.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.belarusian: Дабярыся да порта і папрасі дапамогі ў Эўрара Клэра.

Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.english: Go to Measurehead on the gates and ask him to get the body down.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.polish: Idź do Miarogłowego na bramie i poproś go o ściągnięcie ciała.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.belarusian: Ідзі да Мерагаловага на браме і папрасі яго зняць цела.

Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.english: Go to the yard and see what Measurehead accomplished.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.polish: Idź na podwórze i zobacz, czego dokonał Miarogłowy.
Conversation/0x0100002B000081C7/subtask_.belarusian: Ідзі на падворак і паглядзі, чаго дасягнуў Мерагаловы.

Conversation/0x0100002B000082E2/Descript.english: The working class woman you met in front of the bookstore admitted that her husband is missing. Chances are the guy is drinking somewhere with his buddies. Find him and bring him home, if possible.
Conversation/0x0100002B000082E2/Descript.polish: Kobieta z klasy robotniczej, którą spotkałeś przed księgarnią, przyznała, że jej mąż zaginął. Jest duża szansa, że pije gdzieś z kumplami. Jeśli to możliwe, znajdź go i sprowadź do domu.
Conversation/0x0100002B000082E2/Descript.belarusian: Жанчына з рабочага класа, якую ты сустрэў перад кнігарняй, прызналася, што яе муж знік. Хутчэй за ўсё, ён дзесьці п'е з сябрукамі. Калі атрымаецца, знайдзі яго і прывядзі дадому.

Conversation/0x0100002B00037BC2/Descript.english: The lead seals that secure the goods have been broken off.
Conversation/0x0100002B00037BC2/Descript.polish: Chroniące towar ołowiane pieczęci zostały odłamane.
Conversation/0x0100002B00037BC2/Descript.belarusian: Свінцовыя пломбы, што засцерагалі тавар, былі адламаныя.

Conversation/0x0100002B00037C54/Descript.polish: Zapakowany w plastik makaron opatrzony pieczęcią „Pomoc humanitarna”.
Conversation/0x0100002B00037C54/Descript.belarusian: Макароны ў паліэтыленавым пакаванні са штэмпелем "Гуманітарная дапамога".

Conversation/0x0100002B00040EFB/Descript.english: A bold slogan "HUMANOX" covers the truck.
Conversation/0x0100002B00040EFB/Descript.polish: Na ciężarówce widnieje napisane dużymi literami słowo „HUMANOX”.

Conversation/0x0100002B00040F97/Descript.polish: Napis głosi: „Tuńczyk z pomocy humanitarnej. NIE NA SPRZEDAŻ”.

Conversation/0x0100002B00085B2B/Descript.belarusian: Правады інтэркома цягнуцца да скрыні з засцерагальнікамі.

Conversation/0x0100002B00085B62/Descript.english: Someone has stuck some busted guns beneath the ceiling.

Conversation/0x0100002B00085B62/Descript.belarusian: Хтосьці засунуў пад столь паламаную зброю.

Conversation/0x0100002B00085B73/Descript.english: An ice cream maker, defrosted and unplugged.
Conversation/0x0100002B00085B73/Descript.polish: Maszynka do lodów, rozmrożona i odłączona od zasilania.
Conversation/0x0100002B00085B73/Descript.belarusian: Машына для марозіва, размарожаная і адключаная ад сеткі.

Conversation/0x0100002B000861D7/Descript.english: Help Revachol Ice City cut their losses by plugging out the giant ice bear fridge. It's located in the cellar of the Doomed Commercial Area.
Conversation/0x0100002B000861D7/Descript.polish: Pomóż Revacholskiemu Miastu Lodów zminimalizować straty, odłączając od prądu wielką lodówkę lodowego niedźwiedzia. Znajdziesz ją w piwnicy Zgubionej Strefy Handlowej.

Conversation/0x0100002B00086ED0/Descript.polish: Zniszczona drabinka gimnastyczna. Nie wygląda bezpiecznie.

Conversation/0x0100002B00086EDE/Descript.english: The hallway is blocked by old windowpanes and debris.
Conversation/0x0100002B00086EDE/Descript.polish: Korytarz jest zablokowany starymi witrynami okiennymi i gruzem.
Conversation/0x0100002B00086EDE/Descript.belarusian: Калідор завалены старымі аконнымі шыбамі і друззам.

Conversation/0x0100002B00086EFB/Descript.english: But where are the clothes it used to display?
Conversation/0x0100002B00086EFB/Descript.polish: Ale gdzie są ubrania, które na nim pokazywano?
Conversation/0x0100002B00086EFB/Descript.belarusian: Але дзе адзежа, якую на ім выстаўлялі?

Conversation/0x0100002F00008EB5/Descript.english: There's a mysterious pair of eerie eyes peeking through the gap between the main gates.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008EB5/Descript.polish: Spomiędzy szczeliny w głównej bramie wygląda tajemnicza para upiornych oczu.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008EB5/Descript.belarusian: Скрозь шчыліну ў галоўнай браме выглядае таямнічая пара жудасных вачэй.

Conversation/0x0100002F00008ED2/Descript.english: Rumbling and creaking can be heard from behind the large gates.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008ED2/Descript.polish: Zza dużej bramy dobiega hurgot i skrzypienie.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008ED2/Descript.belarusian: З-за вялікай брамы чуваць грукат і скрыгатанне.

Conversation/0x0100002F00008F41/Descript.english: There's no lockpicking or door-kicking this one.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008F41/Descript.polish: Tych drzwi nie otworzy się ani wytrychem, ani kopniakiem.
Conversation/0x0100002F00008F41/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя дзверы не адчыніш ні адмычкай, ні выспяткам.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/Descript.english: Someone's using Terminal B to smuggle raw ingredients of drugs into Revachol. Joyce said there are 3 drivers at the intersection. Talk to them, one of them *must* know something about the drug trade.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/Descript.polish: Ktoś używa Terminala B, by przemycać do Revacholu surowce do produkcji narkotyków. Joyce mówiła, że na skrzyżowaniu jest 3 kierowców. Porozmawiaj z nimi. Jeden z nich *musi* wiedzieć coś o handlu prochami.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/Descript.belarusian: Хтосьці выкарыстоўвае Тэрмінал Б, каб правозіць у Рэвашоль сыравіну для вырабу наркотыкаў. Джойс сказала, што на скрыжаванні стаяць 3 кіроўцы. Пагавары з імі — адзін з іх *мусіць* ведаць нешта пра наркагандаль.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.english: Interrogate the drivers about the smuggling.
Find out who's the lady driver and where's her lorry.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.polish: Dowiedz się, kim jest kierowczyni i gdzie ma swoją ciężarówkę.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.belarusian: Даведайся, хто тая жанчына-кіроўца і дзе яе грузавік.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.english: Search through the lady driver's lorry cabin near the monument.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.polish: Przeszukaj kabinę ciężarówki kierowczyni nieopodal pomnika.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.belarusian: Перашукай кабіну грузавіка жанчыны-кіроўцы каля помніка.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096E6/subtask_.polish: Zgłoś się z powrotem do Joyce.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096F8/Descript.english: Kim suggested you call the station lazareth in order to sort out your health issues. You can use his motor carriage to make the call, although you don't feel hopeful.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096F8/Descript.polish: Kim poradził ci skontaktowanie się z lazaretem komisariatu w sprawie twoich problemów ze zdrowiem. Możesz użyć radia w jego powozie, choć nie wiążesz z tym wielkich nadziei.
Conversation/0x0100002F000096F8/Descript.belarusian: Кім параіў табе звязацца з лазарэтам пастарунка, каб разабрацца з праблемамі са здароўем. Ты можаш скарыстацца ягонай маторнай карэтай, каб патэлефанаваць, хоць і не чакаеш асаблівага плёну.

Conversation/0x0100002F000096F8/Title.polish: Skontaktuj się z lazaretem swojego komisariatu

Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/Descript.english: People say the commercial building on the plaza is cursed; no business will ever thrive there without going bankrupt. You promised Plaisance you'll look into it. Enter the sealed door behind the bookstore and find out what happened to the companies there.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/Descript.polish: Miejscowi twierdzą, że budynek biurowy na placu jest przeklęty – żaden interes tam się nie wzbogaci, a każdy zbankrutuje. Obiecałeś Plaisance, że przyjrzysz się tej sprawie. Wejdź przez zapieczętowane drzwi za księgarnią i sprawdź, co się stało z mającymi tam siedziby firmami.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/Descript.belarusian: Кажуць, што гандлёвы будынак на пляцы пракляты: ніводная справа там не разбагацее і непазбежна збанкрутуе. Ты паабяцаў Плезанс разабрацца з гэтым. Зайдзі праз запячатаныя дзверы за кнігарняй і высветлі, што здарылася з мясцовымі кампаніямі.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.english: Search for the 'malignant Entity'. Plaisance said she lives inside a chimney -- find a way in.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.polish: Poszukaj „złowrogiej istoty”. Plaisance twierdzi, że mieszka ona w kominie. Znajdź sposób, by się tam dostać.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.belarusian: Адшукай 'зласлівую Існасць'. Плезанс сказала, што яна жыве ў коміне — знайдзі шлях усярэдзіну.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.english: Ask the Novelty Dicemaker about the bankrupt companies.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.polish: Spytaj producentkę nietypowych kości o firmy, które zbankrutowały.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.belarusian: Распытай Вытворцу Нетыповых Костак пра збанкрутаваныя кампаніі.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.english: Ask the Novelty Dicemaker about the curse.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.polish: Spytaj producentkę nietypowych kości o klątwę.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.belarusian: Распытай Вытворцу Нетыповых Костак пра праклён.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.english: Report back to Plaisance about your findings.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.polish: Wróć do Plaisance i opowiedz jej o swoich odkryciach.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000970D/subtask_.belarusian: Вярніся да Плезанс і раскажы пра тое, што высветліў.

Conversation/0x0100002F000098E3/Descript.english: Goods from the lorry haphazardly litter the surroundings.

Conversation/0x0100002F00009DAB/Descript.polish: Połyskliwe czasopismo: „Najsprawniejsi mężczyźni”. W tym wydaniu zamieszczono listę top 10.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000D02C/Descript.english: No sane person would ever put their head in to such machine.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000D03C/Descript.belarusian: Выглядае як Гіём ле Мільён... той плакат з прычоскай.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000D462/Descript.english: A quaint picture book brochure. Very colourful.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000D462/Descript.polish: Broszurka z uroczymi obrazkami. Bardzo kolorowa.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000E19C/Descript.english: The underside of the boat has recently been tarred.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000E19C/Descript.polish: Kadłub tej łodzi został niedawno pokryty smołą.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000E234/Descript.english: Kim can answer any lingering questions you may have about the case and the RCM. Join him on the Whirling-in-Rags' balcony after 22:00, when you're calling it a day.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000E234/Descript.polish: Kim odpowie ci na wszelkie pytania, jakie możesz jeszcze mieć w sprawie śledztwa i MOR-u. Dołącz do niego na tarasie Whirling-in-Rags po 22:00, kiedy będziesz kończyć dzień.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000E234/Descript.belarusian: Кім адкажа табе на ўсе пытанні, якія ты можаш яшчэ мець у справе расследавання і РГМ. Далучайся да яго на тэрасе Whirling-in-Rags пасля 22:00, калі будзеш заканчваць дзень.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/Descript.english: Some locusts have gone missing, and the Insulindian phasmid has yet to be found. Perhaps you can use your detective skills to help out the cryptozoologists?
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/Descript.polish: Część szarańczy zniknęła, lecz insulindiański straszyk pozostaje nieodkryty. Może twoje umiejętności detektywistyczne pozwolą ci pomóc kryptozoologom?
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/Descript.belarusian: Знікла частка саранчы, а інсуліндыйскі фазмід усё яшчэ не знойдзены. Можа, твае дэтэктыўныя навыкі дапамогуць крыптазаолагам?

Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.english: Find out the real reason why the trap was empty. Local kids might know.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.polish: Poznaj prawdziwy powód, dla którego pułapka była pusta. Miejscowa dzieciarnia może coś wiedzieć.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.belarusian: Даведайся сапраўдную прычыну, чаму пастка была пустой. Мясцовыя дзеці могуць нешта ведаць.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.english: Ask Cuno about the empty trap, then take a look around the yard.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.polish: Spytaj Cuna o pustą pułapkę, po czym rozejrzyj się po podwórzu.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.belarusian: Спытай Куну пра пустую пастку, а потым агледзься на двары.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.english: Cuno has promised to stop. Report your findings to the cryptozoologists.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.polish: Cuno obiecał, że przestanie. Poinformuj kryptozoologów o swoich odkryciach.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.belarusian: Куно абяцаў, што спыніцца. Паведаміце крыптазаолагам пра свае знаходкі.

Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.english: Tell Morell that you found the locusts in the shack.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.polish: Powiedz Morellowi, że znalazłeś szarańczę w chacie.
Conversation/0x0100002F0000F573/subtask_.belarusian: Скажы Марэлю, што ты знайшоў саранчу ў халупе.

Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/Descript.english: A half-insane joyrider has jumped over the canal. See if you can find evidence of his reckless activity in west, on the coast.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/Descript.polish: Na poły szalony złodziej powozów przeskoczył nad kanałem. Poszukaj śladów jego bezmyślnego zachowania na zachodzie, na wybrzeżu.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/Descript.belarusian: Напаўвар'яцкі ліхач пераскочыў цераз канал. Паглядзі, ці атрымаецца знайсці сляды яго безразважнай выхадкі на захадзе, на ўзбярэжжы.

Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.english: First you should find the vehicle the joyrider used in their escapades.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.polish: Przede wszystkim musisz znaleźć pojazd, którego złodziej używał podczas swoich eskapad.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.belarusian: Спачатку варта знайсці транспартны сродак, якім ліхач карыстаўся падчас сваіх выбрыкаў.

Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.english: You found the joyrider's vehicle -- see what's inside to identify his IDENTITY!
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.polish: Znalazłeś pojazd złodzieja. Sprawdź, co jest w środku, aby poznać jego tożsamość!
Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.belarusian: Ты знайшоў аўтамабіль ліхача — паглядзі, што ўсярэдзіне, каб вызначыць яго АСОБУ!

Conversation/0x0100002F000112A1/Descript.english: You have a date with Lilienne. Get to Land's End -- in the northern tip of the peninsula -- quickly, she's not going to wait for you forever.
Conversation/0x0100002F000112A1/Descript.polish: Masz randkę z Lilienne. Udaj się na Kraniec na północnym końcu półwyspu. Szybko, nie będzie czekać na ciebie w nieskończoność.
Conversation/0x0100002F000112A1/Descript.belarusian: У цябе спатканне з Ліліен. Хутка руш на Край Свету — на паўночны край паўвострава — яна не будзе чакаць цябе вечна.

Conversation/0x0100002F000112A1/Title.polish: Spotkaj się z Lilienne na Krańcu
Conversation/0x0100002F000112A1/Title.belarusian: Сустрэнься з Ліліен на Краі Свету

Conversation/0x0100002F000113F2/Descript.english: An aroma of spices, alcohol, and tomato hangs in the air...
Conversation/0x0100002F000113F2/Descript.polish: W powietrzu unosi się zapach przypraw, alkoholu i pomidorów...
Conversation/0x0100002F000113F2/Descript.belarusian: У паветры лунае водар спецый, алкаголю і памідораў...

Conversation/0x0100002F0001145F/Descript.english: A standard office file cabinet. The drawers seem to be locked.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001145F/Descript.polish: Typowa biurowa szafka na akta. Zdaje się, że szuflady są zamknięte.
Conversation/0x0100002F0001145F/Descript.belarusian: Стандартная офісная шафа для дакументаў. Здаецца, шуфляды замкнёныя.

Conversation/0x0100002F000114BC/Descript.english: The floorboards creak under your step.
Conversation/0x0100002F000114BC/Descript.polish: Deski podłogi skrzypią pod twoim ciężarem.
Conversation/0x0100002F000114BC/Descript.belarusian: Дошкі падлогі рыпяць пад тваімі крокамі.

Conversation/0x0100002F0001182A/Descript.english: A mountain of different board games.

Conversation/0x0100002F00011832/Descript.english: Merely looking at that unmanly haircut threatens your masculinity.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011832/Descript.polish: Samo spoglądanie na tę niemęską fryzurę stanowi zagrożenie dla twojej męskości.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011832/Descript.belarusian: Ад аднаго позірку на гэтую немужчынскую стрыжку твая мужнасць апынаецца пад пагрозай.

Conversation/0x0100002F0001183A/Descript.polish: Książki na prezent i roztopione curkierki.

Conversation/0x0100002F00011841/Descript.english: Another boring book. Just discarded here.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011841/Descript.polish: Kolejna nudna książka. Ktoś ją to po prostu zostawił.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011841/Descript.belarusian: Яшчэ адна нудная кніга. Проста кінутая тут.

Conversation/0x0100002F00011848/Descript.english: The book collects the national recipes of Arda. They are all about lake trout.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011848/Descript.polish: Książka będąca zbiorem narodowych przepisów Ardy. Do każdego niezbędna jest palia.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011848/Descript.belarusian: Кніга змяшчае нацыянальныя рэцэпты Арды. Усе яны пра азёрнага гальца.

Conversation/0x0100002F00011851/Descript.english: It's a... *Tome of Fascist Magic*. Rather candid.
Conversation/0x0100002F00011851/Descript.polish: To... *Tom faszystowskiej magii*. Dość mało znany.

Conversation/0x0100003100006766/Descript.english: Due to some confusion over the game René and Gaston are playing, you threw one of their pétanque *boules* far in the sea. The shot was excellent, but now you owe them a *boule*... or at least similar-looking metal sphere.
Conversation/0x0100003100006766/Descript.polish: Nie do końca zrozumiawszy zasady gry, której oddają się René i Gaston, rzuciłeś jedną z *bul* daleko w morze. Sam rzut był doskonały, teraz jednak musisz im oddać albo *bulę*, albo chociaż podobnie wyglądającą metalową kulę.
Conversation/0x0100003100006766/Descript.belarusian: Праз непаразуменне наконт гульні, у якую гуляюць Рэнэ і Гастон, ты шпурнуў адну з іх *буль* для петанка далёка ў мора. Кідок быў выдатны, але цяпер ты вінен ім *булю*... ці прынамсі падобную на выгляд металічную кулю.

Conversation/0x0100003100006790/Descript.english: You tried to punch Cuno and failed catastrophically. Now you need to make a truce with him to gain access to his knowledge. Offer him something he might like. Smokes? A "Man from Hjelmdall" book?
Conversation/0x0100003100006790/Descript.polish: Probowałeś uderzyć Cuna i poniosłeś sromotną klęskę. Musisz teraz zawrzeć z nim pokój, jeśli ma podzielić się z tobą wiedzą. Daj mu coś, co mu się spodoba. Papierosy? Książkę „Człowiek z Hjelmdallu”?
Conversation/0x0100003100006790/Descript.belarusian: Ты паспрабаваў ударыць Куну і з трэскам праваліўся. Цяпер табе трэба скласці з ім перамір'е, каб атрымаць доступ да яго ведаў. Прапануй яму штосьці, што яму спадабаецца. Цыгарэты? Кнігу "Чалавек з Хэймдаля"?

Conversation/0x010000310000679B/Descript.english: Seems like your green snakeskin shoe is missing its partner. You should find it before you go venturing into the wild unknown. Two shoes are better than one -- unite them again.
Conversation/0x010000310000679B/Descript.polish: Twojemu zielonemu butowi z wężowej skóry brakuje partnera. Lepiej go poszukaj, zanim wyruszysz w nieznany świat. Dwa buty są lepsze niż jeden – czas je ponownie zjednoczyć.
Conversation/0x010000310000679B/Descript.belarusian: Здаецца, твайму зялёнаму чаравіку са змяінай скуры бракуе пары. Варта знайсці яго, перш чым выпраўляцца ў дзікую невядомасць. Два чаравікі лепш, чым адзін — уз'яднай іх зноў.

Conversation/0x01000031000067A3/Descript.english: The cafeteria manager of the Whirling-in-Rags might know something about the murder that happened in the yard. Ask him about it.
Conversation/0x01000031000067A3/Descript.polish: Kierownik baru w Whirling-in-Rags może wiedzieć coś o morderstwie, do którego doszło na podwórzu. Spytaj go o nie.
Conversation/0x01000031000067A3/Descript.belarusian: Кіраўнік бара ў Whirling-in-Rags можа ведаць нешта пра забойства, якое адбылося ў двары. Спытай яго пра гэта.

Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/Descript.english: Inspect the body hanging in the back yard of the Whirling-in-Rags. This is a preliminary inspection, you just need to suppress the urge to throw up and approach it.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/Descript.polish: Obejrzyj ciało wiszące na tyłach Whirling-in-Rags. To tylko wstępna inspekcja, wystarczy, że powstrzymasz odruch wymiotny i do niego podejdziesz.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/Descript.belarusian: Агледзь цела, што вісіць на заднім двары Whirling-in-Rags. Гэта папярэдні агляд — табе трэба толькі здушыць ванітавы рэфлекс і падысці да яго.

Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.english: Get ammonia from the gardener or the Frittte store, it'll make it easier.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.polish: Zdobądź amoniak od ogrodniczki lub ze sklepu Frittte, ułatwi ci zadanie.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.belarusian: Дастань аміяк у садоўніцы ці ў краме Frittte — гэта палегчыць задачу.

Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.english: Equip and complete "Volumetric Shit Compressor" thought.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.polish: Wyposaż się w myśl „wolumetryczny ogarniacz gówna” i przeanalizuj ją.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.belarusian: Экіпіруйся думкай "Аб'ёмны Упарадкавальнік Гаўна" і абдумай яе.

Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.english: You're in, do a preliminary inspection of its different parts.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.polish: No to do roboty. Przeprowadź wstępną inspekcję poszczególnych części ciała.
Conversation/0x01000031000067AB/subtask_.belarusian: Пачатак пакладзены, правядзі папярэдні агляд розных частак цела.

Conversation/0x01000031000067B3/Descript.english: You need to report your missing badge to the 41st Precinct as soon as possible. The lieutenant said that you can use the radio in his motorcar to call your station.
Conversation/0x01000031000067B3/Descript.polish: Musisz najszybciej, jak to możliwe, zgłosić zaginięcie swojej odznaki 41. komisariatowi. Porucznik powiedział, że możesz wezwać swój posterunek przez radio w jego wozie.
Conversation/0x01000031000067B3/Descript.belarusian: Ты мусіш як мага хутчэй паведаміць пра знікненне свайго значка 41-му пастарунку. Лейтэнант сказаў, што ты можаш скарыстацца радыё ў яго машыне, каб звязацца са сваім пастарункам.

Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Descript.english: You need to find 20 reál to pay for your room at the Whirling, or it will be locked after 21.00. As long as you don't have a free place to stay you have to do this every night.
Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Descript.polish: Musisz zdobyć 20 reáli, aby zapłacić za pokój w Whirling, inaczej zostanie zamknięty po 21:00. Dopóki nie masz darmowego miejsca do spania, będziesz musiał robić to każdej nocy.
Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Descript.belarusian: Табе трэба знайсці 20 рэалаў, каб заплаціць за свой пакой у Whirling, інакш яго замкнуць пасля 21:00. Пакуль у цябе няма бясплатнага месца, дзе спыніцца, табе давядзецца рабіць гэта штоноч.

Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Title.english: Find money for rent and pay Garte
Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Title.polish: Znajdź pieniądze i zapłać Garte'owi za pokój
Conversation/0x01000031000067C3/Title.belarusian: Знайдзі грошы на пакой і заплаці Гарту

Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/Descript.english: You need to pay for the damages you caused in the Whirling-in-Rags, or you won't have a place to stay tonight. Ask around for money and be careful with your spending. If you're unsure how much you owe, ask Garte.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/Descript.polish: Musisz zapłacić za szkody, jakie wyrządziłeś w Whirling-in-Rags, albo nie będziesz miał gdzie dziś spać. Spytaj kilka osób o pieniądze i uważaj, na co je wydajesz. Jeśli nie wiesz, ile dokładnie jesteś winien, spytaj Garte'a.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/Descript.belarusian: Ты мусіш заплаціць за шкоду, якую нанёс у Whirling-in-Rags, інакш табе не будзе дзе пераначаваць сёння. Папытайся грошай у людзей і будзь асцярожны з выдаткамі. Калі ты не ўпэўнены, колькі вінен, спытай Гарта.

Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.english: Ask your station for additional funds.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.belarusian: Папрасі ў свайго пастарунка дадатковыя сродкі.

Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.english: Kim has offered to help -- go to his motor carriage in front of the Whirling.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.polish: Kim zaproponował pomoc. Idź do jego powozu motorowego stojącego przed Whirling.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.belarusian: Кім прапанаваў дапамагчы — ідзі да яго маторнай карэты перад Whirling.

Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.english: Take spinner hubcaps to local pawnshop, south of the plaza.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.polish: Zabierz kołpaki do miejscowego lombardu na południe od placu.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.belarusian: Занясі спінэры ў мясцовы ламбард на поўдзень ад пляца.

Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.english: Return to Garte with spinner cash.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.polish: Wróć do Garte'a z pieniędzmi za kołpaki.
Conversation/0x01000031000067CB/subtask_.belarusian: Вярніся да Гарта з грашыма за спінэры.

Conversation/0x01000031000067D3/Descript.english: You need to get your hands on some cigarettes and then smoke them... for those massive bonuses. Find a pack, put it in your hand (equip it in the HELD slot in your INVENTORY), and the smokes will do the rest.
Conversation/0x01000031000067D3/Descript.polish: Musisz dorwać jakieś papierosy i zapalić... żeby dostać potężne premie. Znajdź paczkę, weź ją do ręki (umieść w miejscu „L ręka” lub „P ręka” w EKWIPUNKU), a papierosy załatwią resztę.
Conversation/0x01000031000067D3/Descript.belarusian: Ты мусіш дастаць цыгарэты і закурыць іх... дзеля гэтых вялізных бонусаў. Знайдзі пачак, вазьмі яго ў руку (экіпіруй у слот У РУЦЭ ў сваім РЫШТУНКУ), а цыгарэты зробяць усё астатняе.

Conversation/0x0100003100006E87/Descript.english: Sylvie asked you to talk to Garte and tell him she's sorry. Go to the cafeteria manager and relay the news, maybe it will help you somehow?
Conversation/0x0100003100006E87/Descript.polish: Sylvie poprosiła, żebyś porozmawiał z Garte'em i powiedział mu, że jest jej przykro. Idź do kierownika baru i przekaż nowiny. Może jakoś ci to pomoże?
Conversation/0x0100003100006E87/Descript.belarusian: Сільві папрасіла цябе пагаварыць з Гартам і сказаць яму, што ёй шкада. Ідзі да кіраўніка бара і перадай навіны, можа, гэта табе неяк дапаможа?

Conversation/0x0100003100006E87/Title.polish: Porozmawiaj z Garte'em w imieniu Sylvie
Conversation/0x0100003100006E87/Title.belarusian: Пагавары з Гартам ад імя Сільві

Conversation/0x01000031000073ED/Descript.english: Lieutenant Kitsuragi does not want you to hear about something called the *pale*, probably thinking it will prove traumatic. Return to Joyce once he is not there, and ask her about it. *Or* get him to step away for a second.
Conversation/0x01000031000073ED/Descript.polish: Porucznik Kitsuragi nie chce, żebyś usłyszał cokolwiek o czymś zwanym *szarotą*, myśląc zapewne, że okaże się to traumatyczne. Wróć do Joyce, kiedy go tam nie będzie, i spytaj ją, o co chodzi. *Albo też* nakłoń go, żeby na chwilę się oddalił.
Conversation/0x01000031000073ED/Descript.belarusian: Лейтэнант Кіцурагі не хоча, каб ты пачуў што-небудзь пра штосьці, што называецца *эдэльвейс*, думаючы, верагодна, што гэта акажацца траўматычным. Вярніся да Джойс, калі яго там не будзе, і спытай у яе, што мае на ўвазе. *Ці таксама* прымусь яго адысці на некаторы час.

Conversation/0x01000031000073ED/Title.english: Talk to Joyce about the pale without Kim
Conversation/0x01000031000073ED/Title.polish: Porozmawiaj z Joyce o szarocie bez Kima w pobliżu
