Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/Descript.english: Someone reported the hanging to the RCM. Maybe if you find out who it was, it may shed new light on the events. You have an idea where to start, but the caller could have been anyone.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/Descript.polish: Ktoś zgłosił MOR-owi powieszenie. Może jeśli dowiesz się, kto to zrobił, wydarzenia nabiorą nieco więcej sensu. Wiesz, od czego warto zacząć, ale zgłaszającym mógł być właściwie każdy.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/Descript.belarusian: Хтось паведаміў РГМ пра павешанне. Можа, калі даведашся, хто гэта зрабіў, падзеі стануць крыху больш зразумелымі. Ведаеш, з чаго варта пачаць, але заяўнікам мог быць фактычна любы.

Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/Title.english: Who made the call reporting the crime?

Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.english: Call Sylvie using Kim's shortwave to ask whether she made the call.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.polish: Skontaktuj się z Sylvie, używając krótkofalówki Kima, i spytaj, czy to ona złożyła zawiadomienie.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.belarusian: Патэлефануй Сільві праз рацыю Кіма і спытай, ці гэта яна тэлефанавала.

Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.english: Keep searching for the caller -- despite lacking any obvious leads. (This might take some time)
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.polish: Szukaj dalej dzwoniącej osoby mimo braku oczywistych tropów (może to zająć nieco czasu).
Conversation/0x010000450000EDC3/subtask_.belarusian: Працягвай шукаць таго, хто тэлефанаваў, — нягледзячы на адсутнасць відавочных зачэпак. (Гэта можа заняць пэўны час)

Conversation/0x010000450000EDD0/Descript.english: When Kim's not around to stop you, ask Klaasje about what she heard from her room the night before you emerged into Reality. She must know something.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDD0/Descript.polish: Kiedy Kima nie będzie w pobliżu, spytaj Klaasje, co słyszała ze swojego pokoju w noc poprzedzającą twoje pojawienie się w tej rzeczywistości. Musi coś wiedzieć.
Conversation/0x010000450000EDD0/Descript.belarusian: Калі Кіма не будзе побач, каб табе перашкодзіць, спытай у Клаас'е, што яна чула са свайго пакоя ў ноч перад тым, як ты вынырнуў у рэчаіснасць. Яна мусіць нешта ведаць.

Conversation/0x010000450000EE57/Descript.english: There are strange doors in the Whirling. No one knows where they lead. Find a way in and see what's hidden there, in the hostel cafeteria's forgotten corners.
Conversation/0x010000450000EE57/Descript.polish: W Whirling są pewne dziwne drzwi – nikt nie wie, dokąd prowadzą. Znajdź sposób, aby tam wejść, i zobacz, co kryje się w zapomnianych zakątkach baru.
Conversation/0x010000450000EE57/Descript.belarusian: У Whirling ёсць дзіўныя дзверы. Ніхто не ведае, куды яны вядуць. Знайдзі спосаб патрапіць усярэдзіну і паглядзі, што схавана ў забытых кутках кафетэрыя.

Conversation/0x010000450000EE57/subtask_.english: Find a way into the secret passage.

Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/Descript.english: You need to find a sufficiently tragic tape, then play it on a boombox to memorize the lyrics. Then ask the cafeteria manager to perform. (Preferably in the evening. More people at the bar then.)
Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/Descript.polish: Musisz znaleźć odpowiednio tragiczne nagranie, a następnie puścić je w odtwarzaczu, żeby zapamiętać słowa. Następnie poproś kierownika baru o pozwolenie na występ (najlepiej wieczorem – w barze jest wtedy więcej ludzi).
Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/Descript.belarusian: Вы павінны знайсці адпаведна трагічны запіс, а потым прайграць яго ў прайгравальніку, каб запомніць словы. Пасля гэтага папрасіце мэнэджэра бара дазволу на выступ (лепш увечары — тады ў бары больш людзей).

Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.english: Get hold of a sad song on tape.
Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.polish: Zdobądź nagraną na taśmie smutną piosenkę.

Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.english: Convince Garte to let you sing karaoke.
Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.polish: Przekonaj Garte'a, żeby pozwolił ci zaśpiewać karaoke.
Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.belarusian: Пераканай Гарта дазволіць табе заспяваць у караоке.

Conversation/0x010000450000F6A7/subtask_.english: Get up on the stage in the evening.

Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/Descript.english: Hardie gave you a recording where the hanged man supposedly testifies to his intent to rape and pillage. Have a listen on a playback device -- either in your room; or find one from a pawnshop.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/Descript.polish: Hardie dał ci nagranie, na którym wisielec rzekomo przyznaje się, że planuje gwałcić i rabować. Posłuchaj wypowiedzi na odtwarzaczu u ciebie w pokoju lub zakupionym w lombardzie.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/Descript.belarusian: Хардзі даў табе запіс, на якім павешаны нібыта заяўляе пра свой намер гвалціць і рабаваць. Паслухай яго на якім-небудзь прайгравальніку — альбо ў сваім пакоі, альбо знайдзі які ў ламбардзе.

Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.english: Talk to Klaasje about the Doorgunner Megamix.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z Klaasje o Megamiksie Strzeleckim.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з Клаас'е пра Мегамікс Дзвярнога Кулямётчыка.

Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.english: Talk to Titus about the Doorgunner Megamix.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z Titusem o Megamiksie Strzeleckim.
Conversation/0x0100004500012C9C/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з Цітусам пра Мегамікс Дзвярнога Кулямётчыка.

Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/Descript.english: Klaasje told you she can't talk about him now, but you need *specifics* -- height, build, etc, to confirm your autopsy. Ask a little later, when she has collected herself.
Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/Descript.polish: Klaasje powiedziała, że nie może teraz o nim rozmawiać, ale ty potrzebujesz *konkretów* – wzrostu, budowy ciała i tak dalej – aby potwierdzić wynik autopsji. Spytaj ją później, kiedy się trochę pozbiera.
Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/Descript.belarusian: Клаас'е сказала, што не можа гаварыць пра яго цяпер, але табе патрэбныя *канкрэтныя звесткі* — рост, целасклад і гэтак далей — каб пацвердзіць вынікі аўтапсіі. Спытай яе крыху пазней, калі яна супакоіцца.

Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/Title.english: Question Klaasje about the dead man
Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/Title.polish: Przesłuchaj Klaasje w sprawie zabitego mężczyny

Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/subtask_.english: Return to Klaasje after doing the autopsy, ask her again about the hanged man.
Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/subtask_.polish: Wróć do Klaasje po przeprowadzeniu autopsji i ponownie spytaj ją o wisielca.
Conversation/0x01000045000132B1/subtask_.belarusian: Вярніся да Клаас'е пасля аўтапсіі і зноў спытай яе пра павешанага.

Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Descript.english: Ruby was the organizer of the hanging. She's also *missing*, but the Hardie boys will be tight-lipped about her location. You need to get them to open up. Have you *fully* explored the Whirling? Analysed the site of the murder? Truly and *thoroughly* interrogated Klaasje? All this might make convincing them easier.
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Descript.polish: To Ruby zorganizowała wieszanie. W dodatku *zaginęła*, ale chłopaki Hardiego nie zdradzą ci, gdzie przebywa. Będziesz musiał ich nakłonić do mówienia. Czy na pewno *dokładnie* przeszukałeś Whirling? Przeanalizowałeś miejsce morderstwa? W pełni i *dokładnie* przesłuchałeś Klaasje? Wszystko to może pomóc w ich przekonaniu.
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Descript.belarusian: Твая задача — даведацца пра павешанне. Акрамя таго, *яна знікла*, але хлопцы Хардзі не скажуць табе, дзе яна знаходзіцца. Табе давядзецца прымусіць іх гаварыць. Ці сапраўды ты *дбайна* абшукаў Whirling? Вывучыў месца злачынства? Поўнасцю і *дбайна* апытаў Клаас'е? Усё гэта можа дапамагчы пераканаць іх.

Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Title.english: Make Titus give up Ruby's location
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Title.polish: Skłoń Titusa, żeby powiedział ci, gdzie jest Ruby
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/Title.belarusian: Пераканаць Цітуса сказаць табе, дзе знаходзіцца Рубі.

Conversation/0x0100004500017511/subtask_.english: Titus doesn't believe Ruby shot the hanged man. Present a theory, make him see it's something to consider.
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/subtask_.polish: Titus nie wierzy, żeby to Ruby zastrzeliła wisielca. Przedstaw mu hipotezę, przekonaj go, że jest to możliwość, którą należy rozważyć.
Conversation/0x0100004500017511/subtask_.belarusian: Цітус не верыць, што гэта Рубі застрэліла вісельніка. Прадстаў яму гіпотэзу, пераканай яго, што гэта магчымасць, якую трэба разгледзець.

Conversation/0x0100004500017A03/Descript.english: There's a buoy West of the boardwalk on the coast, somewhere in the reeds. It has Miss Oranje's fake documents in it...
Conversation/0x0100004500017A03/Descript.polish: Na zachód od promenady na wybrzeżu, gdzieś wśród trzcin, jest boja. Są w niej fałszywe dokumenty miss Oranje...
Conversation/0x0100004500017A03/Descript.belarusian: На захад ад праменаду на ўзбярэжжы, недзе ў трыснігу, ёсць буй. У ім ляжаць падробленыя дакументы Міс Аранье...

Conversation/0x0100004500019480/Descript.english: Cigarette butts, cleaned away under a rock: brand Tioumoutiri.
Conversation/0x0100004500019480/Descript.polish: Niedopałki papierosów zamiecione pod kamień. Marka to Tioumoutiri.

Conversation/0x0100004500019487/Descript.english: This ladder is too rusty to climb. The sea air has eaten away at it.
Conversation/0x0100004500019487/Descript.polish: Drabina jest zbyt zardzewiała, by po niej wejść. Zniszczyło ją morskie powietrze.
Conversation/0x0100004500019487/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая драбіна занадта зржавела, каб па ёй узлезці. Яе раз'ела марское паветра.

Conversation/0x010000450001948E/Descript.english: Someone's made a campfire here, a long time ago.
Conversation/0x010000450001948E/Descript.polish: Ktoś dawno temu zrobił tu ognisko.

Conversation/0x0100004500019690/Descript.english: There is a hidden way to arrest Klaasje and have Kim take her to Precinct 57 for safe keeping. She is not to be trusted.
Conversation/0x0100004500019690/Descript.polish: Istnieje ukryty sposób na aresztowanie Klaasje i odesłanie jej pod opieką Kima do 57. komisariatu. Nie wolno jej ufać.
Conversation/0x0100004500019690/Descript.belarusian: Ёсць схаваны спосаб арыштаваць Клаас'е, каб Кім адвёз яе ў Пастарунак 57 дзеля бяспекі. Ёй нельга давяраць.

Conversation/0x0100004500019797/Descript.english: A red thread. Made of nylon. It leads out of the room and onto the roof...
Conversation/0x0100004500019797/Descript.polish: Czerwona nić. Nylonowa. Snuje się z pokoju na dach...
Conversation/0x0100004500019797/Descript.belarusian: Чырвоная нітка. Нейлонавая. Цягнецца з пакоя на дах...

Conversation/0x010000450001979E/Descript.english: Red thread. Made of nylon. It leads into the room...
Conversation/0x010000450001979E/Descript.polish: Czerwona nić. Nylonowa. Snuje się do pokoju...
Conversation/0x010000450001979E/Descript.belarusian: Чырвоная нітка. Нейлонавая. Цягнецца ў пакой...

Conversation/0x01000045000197A5/Descript.english: The thread is tied to the antenna.

Conversation/0x01000045000197AC/Descript.english: The thread is tied to a bookcase on the wall.
Conversation/0x01000045000197AC/Descript.polish: Nić jest przywiązana do ściennej szafki na książki.
Conversation/0x01000045000197AC/Descript.belarusian: Нітка прывязаная да кніжнай паліцы на сцяне.

Conversation/0x0100004500019CA5/Descript.english: There is a secret way to solve the deadlock. It's not easy, includes a lot of back and forth between the two sides, but it's possible. Everything is always possible.
Conversation/0x0100004500019CA5/Descript.polish: Istnieje ukryty sposób na przerwanie impasu. Nie jest łatwy, wymaga pracy po obu stronach, ale da się to zrobić. Wszystko zawsze da się zrobić.
Conversation/0x0100004500019CA5/Descript.belarusian: Ёсць сакрэтны спосаб выйсці з тупіку. Гэта няпроста, патрабуе шмат беганіны паміж двума бакамі, але магчыма. Усё заўсёды магчыма.

Conversation/0x0100004500019CA5/Title.polish: Znajdź sposób na rozwiązanie impasu strajkowego

Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Descript.english: Ruby said you were a notoriously corrupt cop. La Puta Madre's peone. That's why she was scared of you. When you get the chance, call your station to find out more -- *if* you dare.
Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Descript.polish: Ruby twierdzi, że byłeś skorumpowanym do cna gliniarzem. Peonem La Puty Madre. Dlatego właśnie się ciebie bała. Przy najbliższej okazji skontaktuj się z komisariatem, żeby dowiedzieć się więcej – *jeśli* masz odwagę.
Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Descript.belarusian: Рубі сказала, што ты да чорта карумпаваны коп. Пеон La Puta Madre. Вось чаму яна цябе баялася. Калі выпадзе нагода, патэлефануй у свой участак, каб даведацца больш — *калі* асмелішся.

Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Title.english: Are you La Puta Madre's peone?
Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Title.polish: Czy jesteś peonem La Puty Madre?
Conversation/0x010000450001A725/Title.belarusian: Ці ты пеон La Puta Madre?

Conversation/0x010000450001A9C5/Descript.english: Newly replaced glass, shining in the morning light.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9C5/Descript.polish: Nowo wstawiona szyba lśni w blasku poranka.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9C5/Descript.belarusian: Нанова ўстаўленае шкло ззяе ў ранішнім святле.

Conversation/0x010000450001A9CC/Descript.english: This Stereo 8 player has been reunited with its right speaker.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9CC/Descript.polish: Magnetofon Stereo 8 znów ma towarzystwo swojego prawego głośnika.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9CC/Descript.belarusian: Гэты магнітафон Stereo 8 уз'яднаўся са сваёй правай калонкай.

Conversation/0x010000450001A9DA/Descript.english: You see gleaming white enamel. No bottles inside...
Conversation/0x010000450001A9DA/Descript.polish: Lśniąca bielą emalia. Żadnych butelek w środku...
Conversation/0x010000450001A9DA/Descript.belarusian: Ты бачыш бліскучую белую эмаль. Унутры ніякіх бутэлек...

Conversation/0x010000450001A9E3/Descript.english: You hear traffic outside. Back in the world again...
Conversation/0x010000450001A9E3/Descript.polish: Na zewnątrz słyszysz ruch uliczny. Wracamy do świata...
Conversation/0x010000450001A9E3/Descript.belarusian: Звонку чуваць вулічны рух. Зноў вяртанне ў свет...

Conversation/0x010000450001A9FF/Descript.english: The bed still smells of your sweat and blood.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9FF/Descript.polish: Łóżko wciąż czuć twoim potem i krwią.
Conversation/0x010000450001A9FF/Descript.belarusian: Ложак усё яшчэ пахне тваім потам і крывёй.

Conversation/0x010000450001AA09/Descript.english: The alarm is set for 6:50 AM.

Conversation/0x010000450001AA18/Descript.english: Look! The door is open! You can walk right into Kim's room.
Conversation/0x010000450001AA18/Descript.polish: Patrz! Drzwi są otwarte! Możesz tak po prostu wejść do pokoju Kima.
Conversation/0x010000450001AA18/Descript.belarusian: Глядзі! Дзверы адчыненыя! Можна зайсці наўпрост у пакой Кіма.

Conversation/0x010000450001AA55/Descript.english: Medicinal supplies on the cupboard: Merchurochrome, a scalpel, antibiotics...
Conversation/0x010000450001AA55/Descript.polish: Na szafce stoi medyczny zapas: merkurochrom, skalpel, antybiotyki...
Conversation/0x010000450001AA55/Descript.belarusian: Медыцынскія прыпасы на шафцы: меркурахром, скальпель, антыбіётыкі...

Conversation/0x010000450001ABC2/Descript.english: She's left you a note on her table
Conversation/0x010000450001ABC2/Descript.belarusian: Яна пакінула табе запіску на сваім стале

Conversation/0x010000450001B5DA/Descript.english: What it says on the can.

Conversation/0x010000450001B5DA/Title.english: Light the graffito on fire with a burning cigarette

Conversation/0x010000450001BB00/Descript.english: Lilienne mentioned they might have been there on a raft -- the twins are on the concrete yard in the middle of the village.
Conversation/0x010000450001BB00/Descript.polish: Lilienne wspomniała, że mogli dotrzeć tam na tratwie – bliźniaków znajdziesz na betonowym placu pośrodku wsi.
Conversation/0x010000450001BB00/Descript.belarusian: Ліліен згадала, што яны маглі быць там на плыце — блізняты на бетонным двары пасярод вёскі.

Conversation/0x010000450001BB00/Title.english: Ask Lilienne's twins about the island

Conversation/0x010000450001C1BC/Descript.english: These stairs feel ancient... soldier's feet ran up them long ago.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1BC/Descript.polish: Schody wydają się bardzo stare... Dawno temu wbiegali po nich żołnierze.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1BC/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя сходы здаюцца старажытнымі... ногі жаўнераў узбягалі па іх даўным-даўно.

Conversation/0x010000450001C1C9/Descript.english: Some fuel has leaked out of the barrel. Black, viscous.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1C9/Descript.polish: Z beczki wyciekło nieco paliwa. Jest czarne i lepkie.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1C9/Descript.belarusian: З бочкі выцекла трохі паліва. Чорнае, вязкае.

Conversation/0x010000450001C1D0/Descript.english: Warm air -- from the inside of the building. It's warmer there than out here.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1D0/Descript.polish: Ciepłe powietrze, z wnętrza budynku. Temperatura jest w nim wyższa niż na zewnątrz.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1D0/Descript.belarusian: Цёплае паветра — знутры будынка. Там цяплей, чым тут, звонку.

Conversation/0x010000450001C1D6/Descript.english: The rusted chain trails off into the ocean...
Conversation/0x010000450001C1D6/Descript.polish: Zardzewiały łańcuch niknie pod powierzchnią oceanu...

Conversation/0x010000450001C1E2/Descript.english: This barrel says: ICM. You see a star with little specks in it.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1E2/Descript.polish: Na beczce widnieje napis: MOI. Dostrzegasz też gwiazdę z małymi kropkami.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1E2/Descript.belarusian: На гэтай бочцы напісана: МКМ. Ты бачыш зорку з маленькімі плямкамі ўнутры.

Conversation/0x010000450001C1F5/Descript.english: The chain trails off into the ocean -- to who knows where.
Conversation/0x010000450001C1F5/Descript.polish: Łańcuch niknie pod powierzchnią oceanu. Kto wie, dokąd dociera?
Conversation/0x010000450001C1F5/Descript.belarusian: Ланцуг цягнецца ў акіян — хто ведае куды.

Conversation/0x010000450001C366/Descript.english: Be careful not to fall... the cliff face looks steep.
Conversation/0x010000450001C366/Descript.polish: Uważaj, żeby nie spaść... Klif wydaje się być stromy.
Conversation/0x010000450001C366/Descript.belarusian: Асцярожна, не ўпадзі... абрыў выглядае стромкім.

Conversation/0x010000450001C36C/Descript.english: The little birch from the coin operated viewer. Still holding on.
Conversation/0x010000450001C36C/Descript.polish: Mała brzózka z lornetki na monety. Wciąż się jakoś trzyma.
Conversation/0x010000450001C36C/Descript.belarusian: Маленькая бярозка з манетнага бінокля. Усё яшчэ трымаецца.

Conversation/0x010000450001C46D/Descript.english: Find fuel, then put it in the generator upstairs (to power the console -- to open the door). There could be fuel on the island, tucked away somewhere -- explore, look around.
Conversation/0x010000450001C46D/Descript.polish: Znajdź paliwo, po czym nalej je do generatora na górze (żeby zasilić konsolę i otworzyć drzwi). Może da się je znaleźć schowane gdzieś na wyspie. Eksploruj, rozejrzyj się.
Conversation/0x010000450001C46D/Descript.belarusian: Знайдзі паліва і залі яго ў генератар наверсе (каб засілкаваць кансоль — каб адчыніць дзверы). Паліва можа быць схавана недзе на выспе — даследуй усё вакол, азірніся.

Conversation/0x010000450001C4B5/Descript.english: This barrel has run empty. There's almost nothing inside.
Conversation/0x010000450001C4B5/Descript.polish: Zawartość beczki się skończyła. Prawie nic w niej nie ma.
Conversation/0x010000450001C4B5/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая бочка апусцела. Унутры амаль нічога няма.

Conversation/0x010000450001C6AC/Descript.english: You recognize this little birch. From the coin-operated viewer.
Conversation/0x010000450001C6AC/Descript.polish: Rozpoznajesz tę małą brzózkę. Widziałeś ją przez lornetkę na monety.
Conversation/0x010000450001C6AC/Descript.belarusian: Ты пазнаеш гэтую маленькую бярозку. З манетнага бінокля.

Conversation/0x010000450001C7F0/Descript.english: This was once an armament rest.
Conversation/0x010000450001C7F0/Descript.polish: To było kiedyś miejsce na broń.
Conversation/0x010000450001C7F0/Descript.belarusian: Калісьці тут была апора для зброі.

Conversation/0x010000450001C812/Descript.polish: Lampka do czytania nie ma zasilania.

Conversation/0x010000450001C84C/Descript.english: Canned food, sugar, and other foodstuffs.
Conversation/0x010000450001C84C/Descript.polish: Konserwy, cukier i inne artykuły żywnościowe.

Conversation/0x010000450001C855/Descript.english: Twin cannons were attached here. Medium distance, large calibre.
Conversation/0x010000450001C855/Descript.polish: Stały tu bliźniacze działa. Średnia donośność, duży kaliber.
Conversation/0x010000450001C855/Descript.belarusian: Тут мацаваліся спараныя гарматы. Сярэдняя далёкасць, буйны калібр.

Conversation/0x010000450001C865/Descript.english: The reading lamp emits a soft glow.
Conversation/0x010000450001C865/Descript.belarusian: Лямпа для чытання свеціць мяккім святлом.

Conversation/0x010000450001C876/Descript.english: A moth-bitten bed sheet keeps the wind out.
Conversation/0x010000450001C876/Descript.polish: Przeżarte przez mole prześcieradło chroni wnętrze przed wiatrem.
Conversation/0x010000450001C876/Descript.belarusian: Пабітая моллю прасціна ратуе ад ветру.

Conversation/0x010000450001C9CF/Descript.english: Warm blood trickles down your armpit. The ligature is off... it's *nothing*.
Conversation/0x010000450001C9CF/Descript.polish: Spod pachy cieknie ci ciepła krew. Opatrunek spadł... to *nic takiego*.
Conversation/0x010000450001C9CF/Descript.belarusian: Цёплая кроў струменіць з-пад пахі. Перавязка зляцела... гэта *нічога*.

Conversation/0x010000450001D382/Descript.english: The distant sound of cargo ships... Signal horns echo on the water.
Conversation/0x010000450001D382/Descript.polish: Daleki odgłos statków towarowych... Dźwięk syren niesie się echem po wodzie.
Conversation/0x010000450001D382/Descript.belarusian: Далёкі гул грузавых караблёў... Сігнальныя гудкі рэхам коцяцца па вадзе.

Conversation/0x010000450001D391/Descript.english: You feel eyes on your back. Someone's watching, but you can't say where...
Conversation/0x010000450001D391/Descript.polish: Czujesz na sobie spojrzenie. Ktoś cię obserwuje, ale nie umiesz określić skąd...
Conversation/0x010000450001D391/Descript.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш позірк у спіну. Нехта сочыць, але ты не можаш сказаць адкуль...

Conversation/0x010000450001D398/Descript.english: The winch is broken, rust has eaten what remains of the chain.
Conversation/0x010000450001D398/Descript.polish: Kołowrót jest uszkodzony. Rdza zżera resztki łańcucha.
Conversation/0x010000450001D398/Descript.belarusian: Лябёдка зламаная, іржа зжэрла рэшткі ланцуга.

Conversation/0x010000450001D39E/Descript.english: The depot that supplied this chain is long gone from the coast.
Conversation/0x010000450001D39E/Descript.polish: Magazyn, w którym składowano ten łańcuch, dawno już zniknął z wybrzeża.
Conversation/0x010000450001D39E/Descript.belarusian: Склад, які пастаўляў гэты ланцуг, даўно знік з узбярэжжа.

Conversation/0x010000450001D4AD/Descript.english: A weathered artillery map showing coordinates in the Bay of Revachol.
Conversation/0x010000450001D4AD/Descript.polish: Zniszczona mapa artyleryjska z naniesionymi współrzędnymi w Zatoce Revacholskiej.
Conversation/0x010000450001D4AD/Descript.belarusian: Знішчаная артылерыйская карта з нанесенымі каардынатамі ў Рэвашольскім Заліве.

Conversation/0x010000450001D52D/Descript.english: You take a mental note: Tioumoutiri. Seems important somehow.
Conversation/0x010000450001D52D/Descript.polish: Zapisujesz w pamięci: Tioumoutiri. Wydaje ci się, że to ważne.
Conversation/0x010000450001D52D/Descript.belarusian: Занатоўваеш у памяці: Цюмуціры. Чамусьці гэта здаецца важным.

Conversation/0x010000450001DBB2/Descript.english: Small white maybells, blossoming in the sand.
Conversation/0x010000450001DBB2/Descript.polish: Małe, białe konwalie kwitną wśród piasku.
Conversation/0x010000450001DBB2/Descript.belarusian: Маленькія белыя канваліі цвітуць у пяску.

Conversation/0x010000450001DFB9/Descript.english: The door is back, like you never opened it...
Conversation/0x010000450001DFB9/Descript.polish: Drzwi znów tu są, jakbyś w ogóle ich nie otwierał...
Conversation/0x010000450001DFB9/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы зноў тут, нібыта ты іх і не адчыняў...

Conversation/0x010000450001DFC0/Descript.english: The door is still here, closed. Feels strange somehow. You can't get in.
Conversation/0x010000450001DFC0/Descript.polish: Drzwi wciąż tu są, zamknięte. Wydaje ci się to dziwne. Nie możesz wejść.
Conversation/0x010000450001DFC0/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы ўсё яшчэ тут, зачыненыя. Нейкае дзіўнае адчуванне. Ты не можаш увайсці.

Conversation/0x010000450001DFD2/Descript.english: Now do it -- walk into the *water*.
Conversation/0x010000450001DFD2/Descript.polish: A teraz zrób to. Wejdź do *wody*.
Conversation/0x010000450001DFD2/Descript.belarusian: А цяпер зрабі гэта — заходзь у *ваду*.

Conversation/0x010000450001F2C1/Descript.english: Put the Advanced Race Theory idea into a free *internalizing* slot in your head. (If there are no free slots, free one up). Then pass some time and when it's internalized, return to Measurehead. This is how thinking is done!
Conversation/0x010000450001F2C1/Descript.polish: Umieść zaawansowaną teorię rasy w wolne miejsce internalizacji w swojej głowie (jeśli wszystkie są zajęte, zwolnij któreś). Poczekaj, aż upłynie nieco czasu, a kiedy internalizacja dobiegnie końca, wróć do Miarogłowego. Tak właśnie wygląda myślenie!
Conversation/0x010000450001F2C1/Descript.belarusian: Змясці ідэю пра перадавую расавую тэорыю ў вольны слот для *інтэрналізацыі* ў сваёй галаве. (Калі вольных слотаў няма, вызвалі адзін). Потым пачакай пэўны час, і калі яна інтэрналізуецца, вярніся да Мерагаловага. Вось як трэба думаць!

Conversation/0x010000450001FD84/Descript.english: Nothing on the front page rings a bell. Strange...
Conversation/0x010000450001FD84/Descript.polish: Nic na pierwszej stronie nie nasuwa ci skojarzeń. Dziwne...
Conversation/0x010000450001FD84/Descript.belarusian: Нішто на першай старонцы табе ні аб чым не гаворыць. Дзіўна...

Conversation/0x010000450001FDBD/Descript.english: The sound of melting snow dripping off the roof... it's strange.
Conversation/0x010000450001FDBD/Descript.polish: Dźwięk topniejącego i skapującego z dachu śniegu jest... dziwny.
Conversation/0x010000450001FDBD/Descript.belarusian: Гук расталага снегу, які капае з даху... нейкі дзіўны.

Conversation/0x010000450002018A/Descript.english: A heap of snow melts in this wheelbarrow.
Conversation/0x010000450002018A/Descript.belarusian: У гэтай тачцы растае куча снегу.

Conversation/0x0100004B0000195A/Descript.english: Fires after you've heard the Twins testimony with Kim. He reveals he knows the station. Weird if true, worth giving them a call.
Conversation/0x0100004B0000195A/Descript.polish: Aktywuje się po usłyszeniu zeznań bliźniaków podczas rozmowy z Kimem. Ujawnia, że zna ten komisariat. Dziwne, jeśli to prawda. Warto tam zadzwonić.
Conversation/0x0100004B0000195A/Descript.belarusian: Спрацоўвае пасля таго, як ты пачуеш паказанні блізнят разам з Кімам. Ён раскрывае, што ведае гэты пастарунак. Дзіўна, калі гэта праўда; варта туды патэлефанаваць.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001AE3/Descript.english: Speedfreaks FM confirmed that the kids heard the Speedfreaks. He doesn't know what that means or how it relates to your case, but suggests you go back to the FELD Mural.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001AE3/Descript.polish: Spiker z radia Naspeedowani FM potwierdził, że to właśnie ich słyszały dzieciaki. Nie wie, co to oznacza ani jaki to ma związek z twoją sprawą, ale radzi ci wrócić do muralu Felda.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001AE3/Descript.belarusian: На радыё 'Хуткарэзы FM' пацвердзілі, што дзеці чулі менавіта іх. Ён не ведае, што гэта значыць і як датычыцца тваёй справы, але раіць вярнуцца да мурала Feld.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/Descript.english: The Wind spoke to you at the Feld Mural. The Children of the Sea know something that will assist you in finding Ruby. But who are the Children and what do they know?
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/Descript.polish: Wiatr przemówił do ciebie przy muralu Felda. Dzieci Morza wiedzą coś, co pomoże ci w znalezieniu Ruby. Kim one jednak są i co mogą wiedzieć?
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/Descript.belarusian: Вецер прамовіў да цябе каля мурала Feld. Дзеці Мора ведаюць нешта, што дапаможа табе знайсці Рубі. Але хто гэтыя Дзеці і што яны ведаюць?

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/Title.english: Work with the Children of the Big Sea
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/Title.polish: Nawiąż współpracę z Dziećmi Wielkiego Morza

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Find the Children of the Big Sea.
Speak to Lillienne's Twins again with Kim present.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj ponownie z bliźniakami Lilienne w obecności Kima.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з блізнятамі Ліліен зноў у прысутнасці Кіма.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Call Speedfreaks FM from the lieutenant's Kineema.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Połącz się z radiem Naspeedowani FM z kineemy porucznika.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Далучайцеся да радыё Naspeedowani FM з кінэмі лейтэнанта.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Ask Lillienne's Twins where they were when they heard Speedfreaks FM.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Spytaj bliźniaków Lilienne, gdzie byli, kiedy usłyszeli Naspeedowanych FM.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Спытай у блізнят Ліліен, дзе яны былі, калі пачулі 'Хуткарэзы FM'.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Put the pieces together at the Feld Mural.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Połącz wątki ze sobą przy muralu Felda.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Збяры ўсе кавалачкі разам каля мурала Feld.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Ask the Washerwoman if she's heard the radio lately.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Spytaj praczkę, czy nie słyszała ostatnio radia.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Спытай у прачкі, ці не чула яна апошнім часам радыё.

Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.english: Ask the Washerwoman about the radio -- with Kim.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.polish: Spytaj praczkę o radio w obecności Kima.
Conversation/0x0100004B00001C82/subtask_.belarusian: Спытай у прачкі пра радыё — у прысутнасці Кіма.

Conversation/0x0100004C000065A6/Descript.english: You see faded industrial lettering on the platform: KVALSUND.
Conversation/0x0100004C000065A6/Descript.polish: Na platformie widzisz wyblakły napis techniczną czcionką: KVALSUND.
Conversation/0x0100004C000065A6/Descript.belarusian: Ты бачыш выцвілы прамысловы надпіс на платформе: KVALSUND.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/Descript.english: Evrart asked you to open the basement door behind the greenhouse in the backyard, to intimidate the occupant. Do what you have to do, Evrart has promised to give you info on the case in return.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/Descript.polish: Evrart poprosił cię o otworzenie drzwi do sutereny za szklarnią na podwórzu w celu zastraszenia mieszkającej tam osoby. Zrób, co masz zrobić. Evrart obiecał, że w zamian przekaże ci informacje dotyczące sprawy.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/Descript.belarusian: Эўрар папрасіў цябе адчыніць дзверы ў падвал за цяпліцай на двары, каб напалохаць чалавека, які там жыве. Зрабі тое, што трэба. Эўрар абяцаў, што ўзамен перадасць табе інфармацыю, якая датычыцца справы.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/Title.polish: Otwórz dla Evrarta drzwi do mieszkania
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/Title.belarusian: Адкрый для Эўрара дзверы ў кватэру.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.english: Get the key to the weasel's door from Mañana.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.polish: Zdobądź od Mañany klucz do drzwi szczura.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.belarusian: Вазьмі ў Mañana ключ ад дзвярэй ласкі.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.english: You have the key. The door is behind the greenhouse in the yard. A basement door.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.polish: Masz klucz. Drzwi są za szklarnią na podwórzu. Piwniczne.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.belarusian: Ключ у цябе. Дзверы знаходзяцца за цяпліцай у двары. Дзверы ў склеп.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.english: *Or* you can lie to Evrart that you opened the weasel's door.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.polish: *Możesz też* skłamać Evrartowi, że otworzyłeś drzwi do domu szczura.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.belarusian: *Можаш таксама* схлусіць Эўрару, што адчыніў дзверы да дому пацука.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.english: Let Evrart know you unlocked the door.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009BEF/subtask_.belarusian: Паведамі Эўрару, што ты адамкнуў дзверы.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/Descript.english: Get Isobel and Lilienne in the nameless fishing village down the coast to sign Evrart's document. Once the signatures are secured, mail the document to Evrart's accountant using the mail box on the plaza in front of the Whirling.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/Descript.polish: Nakłoń Isobel i Lilienne w nienazwanej wsi rybackiej na wybrzeżu do podpisania dokumentu Evrarta. Kiedy będziesz mieć już ich podpisy, prześlij papiery do jego księgowego, korzystając ze skrzynki na placu przed Whirling.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/Descript.belarusian: Нахілі Ізабэль і Ліліен у неназванай рыбацкай вёсцы на ўзбярэжжы да падпісання дакумента Эўрара. Калі ў цябе ўжо будуць іх подпісы, перадай паперы яго бухгалтару, скарыстаўшыся скрыняй на плошчы перад Whirling.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.english: Find someone to sign the document instead the intended signees.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.polish: Znajdź kogoś, kto podpisze dokument za osoby, które powinny to zrobić.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзіце каго-небудзь, хто падпіша дакумент замест тых, хто мусіў яго падпісаць.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.english: Put the envelope in the mailbox in the plaza.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.polish: Umieść kopertę w skrzynce pocztowej na placu.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.belarusian: Пакладзіце канверт у паштовую скрыню на пляцы.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.english: Forge the signatures, but somewhere private, where you feel safe enough to sleep.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.polish: Podrób podpisy w jakimś ustronnym miejscu, gdzie czułbyś się na tyle bezpieczny, żeby pójść tam spać.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.belarusian: Падрабі подпісы, але дзе-небудзь у зацішным месцы, дзе ты пачуваешся дастаткова бяспечна, каб заснуць.

Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.english: Let Evrart know you mailed the signatures.
Conversation/0x0100004C00009C1E/subtask_.belarusian: Паведаміце Эўрару, што вы адаслалі подпісы.

Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAAB/Descript.english: The wind is corralled by the four-story buildings around this yard.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAAB/Descript.polish: Kilkupiętrowe budynki wokół podwórza trzymają tu wiatr w ryzach.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAAB/Descript.belarusian: Чатырохпавярховыя будынкі вакол гэтага двара трымаюць вецер у аброці.

Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAB4/Descript.english: A set of disorderly footprints heading Southeast.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAB4/Descript.polish: Niezborne ślady stóp wiodące na południowy wschód.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAB4/Descript.belarusian: Бязладныя сляды, якія вядуць на паўднёвы ўсход.

Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAC3/Descript.english: Seems the walker was either very confused or drunk out of his mind.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAC3/Descript.polish: Idący człowiek musiał być albo niezwykle zdezorientowany, albo pijany w sztok.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000AAC3/Descript.belarusian: Здаецца, той, хто тут ішоў, быў альбо вельмі разгублены, альбо п'яны ўшчэнт.

Conversation/0x0100004C0000D859/Descript.english: You should find out what is this *anodic dance* music people are listening to these days. Maybe if you were to stumble upon some young adults later on? This is a long term side-thing, don't fret it.
Conversation/0x0100004C0000D859/Descript.polish: Powinieneś się dowiedzieć, czym jest ta cała muzyka *anodic dance*, której słuchają dzisiaj ludzie. Może natkniesz się później na jakąś młodzież? Tylko bez nerwów, to poboczna sprawa i raczej na dłuższy czas.
